description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: London, Munich, Amsterdam, Paris, Lisbon</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to navigate the entire customer journey, from initial discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept and implementation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Serve as a trusted technical advisor</strong> to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges</strong> by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.</li> <li><strong>Guide qualified prospects</strong> through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with sales partners</strong> to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>Analyze customer IT landscapes</strong> and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.</li> <li><strong>Clearly articulate the benefits</strong> and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Enhance customer retention</strong> by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Product Teams</strong> by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <p>Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. security transformation to senior-level executives.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew</li> <li>Proficiency with networking fundamentals, including routing, subnetting, VPNs, and SD-WAN concepts.</li> <li>Understanding of AI agentic architecture and the security requirements and challenges in implementation at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with client operating system fundamentals and software distribution methods.</li> <li>Knowledge of the competitive significant plus.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize effectively among competing goals.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" Additional languages are a plus.</li> <li>Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.</li> <li>Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable skills</h2> <p><strong>Network and security fundamentals</strong></p> <ul> <li>DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.</li> <li>Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Knowledge of end-user and application security risks. These include DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses, ransomware.</li> <li>VPN and remote access challenges, and moving to Zero Trust access.</li> <li>SIEM and log analytics platforms. You should also be comfortable with network telemetry such as NetFlow and sFlow.</li> <li>Experience and knowledge with network and security vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point (covering architecture, capabilities, configuration, and troubleshooting).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Market and competitive knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of the market for CDN providers, Web Application Firewalls, remote access solutions, next-generation firewalls, CASB, DDoS mitigation, SD-WAN and secure gateway solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cloudflare One and Zero Trust</strong></p> <ul> <li>SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare Zero Trust solutions: Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation, and WARP client deployment.</li> <li>Secure Web Gateway, CASB and DLP.</li> <li>IdP and authentication (SAML, OTP), plus SaaS application integration and tenant controls.</li> <li>Client OS fundamentals and software distribution.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €59,000 - €92,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"> </h3> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0"> </p> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the <strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. </p> <p>Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.</p> <p><br><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.</li> <li>Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.</li> <li>Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.</li> <li>Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.</li> <li>Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.</li> <li>Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.</li> <li>Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.</li> <li>Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.</li> <li>Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <p><em>Must haves:</em></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.</li> <li>Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.</li> <li>Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.</li> <li>Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.</li> <li>The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.</li> <li>Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.</li> <li>Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to haves:</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. title: Product Manager (English/French)
description: <h3><strong>About Unframe</strong></h3> <p>Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.</p> <p>Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.</p> <p>This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.</p> <h3><span class="s1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></span></h3> <p>This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Enterprise Discovery: </strong>Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.</li> <li><strong>Design & Spec AI Solutions: </strong>Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.</li> <li><strong>Drive End-to-End Delivery: </strong>Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.</li> <li><strong>Represent the User & Platform: </strong>Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><span class="s1"><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="5,0,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Bilingual Fluency (English & French):</strong> Fluent in French to connect with users and stakeholders in France, and fluent in English for daily collaboration across our international teams.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Led Discovery: </strong>Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise Stakeholder Management: </strong>Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.</li> <li><strong>Problem-to-Solution Design: </strong>Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.</li> <li><strong>Complex Delivery Execution: </strong>Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>AI Solutions Experience: </strong>Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.</li> <li><strong>Builder Orientation: </strong>Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.</li> <li><strong>Core Competencies: </strong>Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.</li> </ul> <h3><span class="s1"><strong><br>Why join us</strong></span></h3> <p class="p2">At Unframe, you’ll help build AI systems that are already delivering real value to global enterprises - not prototypes, demos, or side projects.</p> <p class="p2">You’ll work with exceptional teammates, collaborate directly with top-tier customers, and have real influence over both the solutions we ship and the evolution of our platform. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where product thinking, technical depth, and creativity come together.</p> <p class="p2">If you enjoy solving hard problems, moving fast, and building practical AI products that actually make it to production - we’d love to meet you.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive - Lyon
description: <p><strong>About OpenTable:</strong></p> <p>With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. </p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture and inclusive environment, and get the benefits, flexibility, and support you need to succeed.</p> <hr> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The Account Executive is responsible for bringing new restaurants onto our dining network through a consultative sales approach.</p> <p>OpenTable’s Account Executive team is dedicated to improving restaurants’ revenue potential by applying best-in-brand front-of-house management and online reservation technology. We are looking for sales professionals who are passionate about the restaurant industry and enjoy working with industry-leading technology.</p> <p><strong>We don't have an office in France so you'll spend much of your week meeting restaurant operators face-to-face across your territory, helping build trusted relationships and close new business.This field-based role combines home working with regular travel across your territory. </strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow your assigned territory by proactively identifying, targeting and winning new restaurant partners through strategic outbound activity and thoughtful market mapping.</li> <li>Build trusted adviser relationships with top and elite restaurants, strengthening long-term partnerships and expanding revenue opportunities within your market.</li> <li>Deliver high-quality, tailored product demos, both virtual and in-person, using data-driven insights to diagnose needs and position OpenTable solutions effectively.</li> <li>Drive sustainable revenue growth by creating compelling commercial opportunities that generate measurable value for restaurateurs and OpenTable alike.</li> <li>Act as a market expert by educating operators on industry trends, competitive insights and performance data, while challenging them to think differently about their business.<br>Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, confidently overcoming objections and navigating competitive environments.</li> <li>Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets while maintaining accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management through Salesforce.</li> <li>Capture and translate customer insights into action by sharing structured feedback with Product and Marketing teams to continuously refine the value proposition.</li> <li>Represent OpenTable within the hospitality community through industry events, networking and active market engagement to strengthen brand presence and credibility.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Please apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant B2B sales experience, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets in fast-paced environments.</li> <li>Native French speaker with professional fluency in English, able to build trust and influence stakeholders across markets.</li> <li>A tenacious, goal-oriented self-starter who leads from the front — proactive in outbound activity, resilient in follow-up, and professionally persistent in driving opportunities forward.</li> <li>Strong discovery and consultative selling skills — confident asking the right questions, uncovering needs, and reframing how customers think about their business.</li> <li>Skilled at negotiation and value-based selling, able to articulate ROI and drive meaningful commercial outcomes during sales engagements.</li> <li>Comfortable using data and analytics to inform decisions, build compelling business cases, and strengthen customer conversations.</li> <li>Excellent time management, presentation and organisational skills, with confidence handling administrative responsibilities You keep stakeholders informed, document decisions, and explain technical problems in language others can act on. Care for the details. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM AND ROLE Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT As Lead R&D Engineer for the Stellaris tritium-breeding blanket, you will build and lead Proxima Fusion’s blanket development from initial concept to first prototype tests. You will translate a defined R&D budget into a small set of parallel breeder-blanket concepts, developed rapidly with external research and industrial partners. Remote maintainability is a fundamental part of the blanket architecture from day one. Each concept must be thought with the power plant architecture in mind and demonstrate how blanket modules can be installed, connected, inspected, replaced and recovered remotely. The objective is to leverage existing public research, challenge the most consequential assumptions, learn from hardware quickly and iterate to a functional blanket concept for our future commercial plant fleet. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own the blanket design from initial requirements through conceptual design, prototype manufacture and testing, with accountability for budget, schedule and technical outcomes. Own the integrated remote-maintenance architecture for each concept, including segmentation, access, handling, service connections, inspection, replacement and recovery from failed operations. Own the compliance analysis across neutronics, thermal hydraulics, structural integrity, materials, tritium, decommissioning, safety and remote maintenance. Own the rapid fail-fast prototype: select what to test and lead its design, procurement, manufacture, instrumentation, commissioning and test campaign on ambitious timelines. Own the translation of test results into updated models, requirements, risk assessments and design decisions. Own and build the multidisciplinary, technical design team. WHO YOU ARE A Master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, nuclear engineering, materials science, chemical engineering, physics or equivalent experience. Have led the development of complex nuclear, thermal, chemical or energy technology from conceptual design into hardware and testing, under budget and time constraints. Able to lead multidisciplinary trade studies without converging prematurely on a preferred solution. Strong knowledge in several relevant domains, such as thermal hydraulics, structural mechanics, neutronics, nuclear materials, tritium systems, high-temperature coolants, corrosion, manufacturing or remote handling. Able to distinguish between analysis that enables a decision and analysis that merely adds detail. Comfortable structuring and managing technical work with external institutes, industrial partners and specialist suppliers. Willing to test critical assumptions early, learn from failure and stop weak development paths. Able to make clear and defensible engineering decisions under uncertainty. Experience with fusion blankets, fission-reactor components, breeder materials, tritium systems or remotely maintained nuclear equipment are an advantage, but are explicitly not necessary. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. Knows when to resolve and when to escalate. Desirable Experience with Gorgias, Shopify or Loop Returns. Knowledge of UK and EU consumer rights for online purchases. Experience in music, merchandise or entertainment retail. An interest in music and the artists we work with. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4>The Team:</h4> <p>Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.</p> <p>Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.</p> <p>The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. We want to turn that around. </strong>With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: <strong>solving cases and keeping people safe</strong>.</p> <p>To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the <strong>Police</strong>.</p> <h4>The Role:</h4> <p>This is not a typical Account Executive role. internal experts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>The Qualifications you need:</h4> <ul> <li> <p>Several years of professional experience <strong>within the German police</strong> within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned.</p> </li> <li> <p>First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. title: Customer Success Manager, Southern Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h1><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h1> <p>Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.</p> <p>Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.</p> <p>En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.</p> <p>Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et</p> <p>de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.</p> <p>En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un</p> <p>marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.</p> <h2><strong> </strong></h2> <h1><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion</li> <li>Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions</li> <li>Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client</li> <li>Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels</li> <li>Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA</li> <li>Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements</li> <li>Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail</li> <li>Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel</li> <li>Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du client, réaliser des bilans commerciaux trimestriels et servir de principal intermédiaire entre le client et Anthropic</li> <li>Contribuer au développement de la marque Anthropic et des relations avec la clientèle en tant que membre de la première équipe de service client de la région, en élaborant, si nécessaire, des processus, des guides opérationnels et des bonnes pratiques adaptés à la zone EMEA et tenant compte des cultures d'entreprise régionales</li> </ul> <h2><strong><br><br></strong></h2> <h1><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Vous avez plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions en contact avec la clientèle (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer ou similaire)</li> <li>Expérience avérée en matière de réussite dans les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation et sur la location de places, avec une bonne compréhension des différents leviers de croissance et des indicateurs de performance associés</li> <li>Maîtrise technique et capacité à comprendre et à articuler les concepts d'IA/ML, les intégrations d'API et les modèles de mise en œuvre logicielle</li> <li>Expérience dans la présentation et la démonstration de produits techniques auprès de publics variés</li> <li>Mentalité stratégique pour identifier les opportunités de croissance et les traduire en plans d'expansion concrets</li> <li>Collaborateur polyvalent qui représente le client avec positivité et proactivité, en mobilisant l'ensemble de l'équipe autour de solutions permettant de répondre aux besoins du client</li> <li>Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à gérer plusieurs relations clients</li> <li>Passion pour l'IA et intérêt pour le développement responsable de systèmes avancés</li> <li>Acquérir de l'expérience en travaillant et en contribuant au développement d'une région en pleine croissance, tout en jonglant avec les fuseaux horaires depuis le siège social situé aux États-Unis</li> <li>Un talent pour mettre de l'ordre dans le chaos et une mentalité enthousiaste de « retrousser ses manches ». Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe</li> <li>(Bonus) Maîtrise du français, de l'allemand, de l'espagnol ou de l'italien</li> </ul> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as an EMEA based Customer Success Manager as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across EMEA helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.</p> <p>You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. </p> <p>In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.</p> <p>Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization.  The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business. </p> <p>As one of our early CSMs in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer - helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build trusting, strategic relationships with key EMEA customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion</li> <li>Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions</li> <li>Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer</li> <li>Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments</li> <li>Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs as the voice of EMEA customers</li> <li>Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment</li> <li>Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows</li> <li>Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value withi

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.</p> <p>Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo’s operations and business.</p> <p>The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.</p> <p>Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.</p> <p>It’s an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you’ll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.</p> <p>Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we’d expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.</p> <p>This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It’s especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Owning the Foundation:</strong> the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.</li> <li><strong>Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture</strong>: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.</li> <li><strong>Product and Planning:</strong> Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.</li> <li><strong>Supporting Engineering Excellence</strong>: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.</li> <li><strong>Long-Term Thinking:</strong> Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.</li> <li><strong>Agentic Development:</strong> Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency:</strong> Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.</li> </ul> <p>📍This role can be based in our <strong>Berlin </strong>tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup <a href="https://careers.wolt.com/en/blog/tech/product-hybrid-work">here</a>.</p> <p>Feel free to check out the <a href="https://blog.wolt.com/engineering/">Wolt Tech Blog</a> for more insight into our culture and technology.</p> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.</li> <li>Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.</li> <li>Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.</li> <li>Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.</li> <li>Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with micro-frontend architecture.</li> <li>Frontend platform engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.</li> <li>Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).</li> <li>Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Impact:</strong> Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.</li> <li><strong>Scale:</strong> Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.</li> <li><strong>Growth:</strong> Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Culture:</strong> Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.</li> </ul> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer - Sell Online
description: <h1>Senior Product Designer – Sell Online</h1> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Sell Online team builds the products that help small business owners run and grow their businesses online — from appointment bookings and online stores to customer management. We're a cross-functional design team embedded across multiple product squads, working closely with product managers and engineers to shape experiences used by millions of merchants worldwide. As we expand our portfolio and grow our engineering capacity, we're looking for a Senior Product Designer who can bring strong visual craft, product thinking, and the confidence to own complex design challenges across several product areas simultaneously.<br><br></p> <p>🎥 Get a feel for our Berlin office: <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9DG64C3moeQ">Take a look</a></p> <h2>What you'll contexts</li> <li>You have proven ability to work with and contribute to design systems at scale</li> <li>You are comfortable with managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders across different product areas at the same time</li> <li>You have a collaborative, curious mindset — someone who listens well, adapts quickly, and can navigate ambiguity without losing momentum</li> </ul> <h2>Why you should join SumUp</h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup<br>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced<br>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success<br>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education<br>💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions<br>🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days<br>🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches<br>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service<br>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. <br><br>Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our <a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/">careers website</a>, and follow our journey on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/sumup/">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/insidesumup/">Instagram</a>, and <a ----- class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. title: Senior Product Designer - POS
description: <h2>About the team</h2> <p>SumUp's Point of Sale (POS) solution helps cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and thousands of other businesses manage their day-to-day operations. Alongside the POS experience, merchants rely on powerful reporting, sales management, and fiscalisation tools to understand their business, stay compliant, and operate with confidence.</p> <p>This role would own these three domains from a design perspective - Reporting, Sales, and Fiscalisation. You'll design the experiences merchants use to analyse performance, manage sales activity, and navigate local fiscal requirements, while helping shape a more unified reporting experience across SumUp's payments, banking, and commerce products.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, and data teams within POS, and collaborate with designers and stakeholders across SumUp to deliver experiences that are clear, trustworthy, and built to scale.</p> <p>🎬 <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9DG64C3moeQ">Take a look at our Berlin office</a></p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end design across Reporting, Fiscalisation, and Sales domains - from discovery and strategy through to production-ready delivery</li> <li>Drive the unification of reporting experiences across Dashboard and Mobile, making complex data clear and accessible for merchants</li> <li>Design holistic flows - title: Senior Silicon Validation Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Oxford, England, UK<br><strong>Working pattern:</strong> Hybrid</p> <p><strong>Role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Silicon Validation Engineer to join our Cryo-CMOS IC team at IonQ Oxford. You will lead the validation and characterisation of analogue and mixed-signal ASICs for our trapped-ion quantum processors, from test planning and platform development through first-silicon bring-up, debug and system integration.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technical role. You will shape our validation architecture, build reusable hardware and software, and provide the evidence needed to make confident silicon acceptance decisions. The work includes room-temperature silicon validation and silicon characterisation at cryogenic temperatures (around 4 kelvin), on packaged parts, chip-on-board assemblies and bare die on a cryogenic probe station.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>You will own validation delivery across chip and system interfaces, working closely with analogue and digital design, verification, modelling, firmware and systems engineers. You will turn requirements into measurable tests, prepare platforms before silicon arrives and resolve failures across the chip, board and software.</p> <p>As a Senior engineer, you will set technical standards, guide other engineers and improve coverage, repeatability and test efficiency across successive ASIC generations.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own the silicon validation strategy, plans, acceptance criteria and readiness reviews, with traceability from block and system requirements to tests, results and unresolved risks.</p> </li> <li> <p>Present the silicon acceptance report to the Cryo-CMOS IC Lead and programme stakeholders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead first-silicon bring-up and characterisation of sample-and-hold and switch arrays, DACs, ADCs, references, amplifiers, switches, regulators, clocking and device-level test structures, across supply, temperature, operating modes and device variation, with sound calibration and measurement uncertainty.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop validation boards, fixtures and reusable Python automation, instrument drivers and regression suites, addressing signal integrity, grounding, power integrity and measurement access, with version-controlled tests and reproducible data analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p>Plan and lead cryogenic measurements with specialist colleagues, including bare-die probing and the cold signal chain, and drive failures to root cause, separating silicon defects from board, firmware and test artefacts and correlating results with simulations, device models and foundry or partner data.</p> </li> <li> <p>Influence testability before tape-out, coordinate validation with external design partners, the foundry and other IonQ sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers and document methods to improve throughput, data quality and reuse.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>You will bring substantial experience in analogue or mixed-signal silicon validation and characterisation, with ownership of multiple silicon bring-up programmes. A degree in electrical or electronic engineering, or equivalent practical experience, is expected. You should combine hands-on laboratory skills with sound judgement on test coverage, measurement confidence and programme risk.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Strong electronics fundamentals and experience validating precision signal chains, data converters or power-management circuits, including their digital control interfaces.</p> </li> <li> <p>Practical expertise with oscilloscopes, precision sources and meters, signal generators, spectrum and logic analysers; confidence designing reliable low-noise, low-leakage measurements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Python programming for instrument control, automated testing and statistical analysis; disciplined use of Git or equivalent version control and maintainable test software.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing and debugging test PCBs, reviewing layouts and working with interfaces such as SPI, I2C, JTAG and custom shift-register chains, alongside embedded firmware or FPGA-based platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>A record of resolving complex chip, board and software interactions through structured experiments and collaboration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience leading technical projects, mentoring engineers and communicating evidence, uncertainty and decisions in clear written reports.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Useful additional experience includes cryogenic or other extreme-temperature testing; wafer or bare-die probing; early-stage IP or test-chip evaluation; FPGA development and C/C++; circuit simulation; and production test correlation. Prior quantum computing is welcome but not required.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.</p> <p>We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.</p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed w

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform (Toqan)
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity Toqan is Prosus's internal AI platform — the infrastructure and tooling layer that powers agentic AI-driven products across the entire group.We are building secure, configurable agent runtimes that can operate reliably at scale across different products, channels and use cases.. You’ll work where distributed systems meet applied AI: orchestrating models and tools, enabling agents to perform long-running work, and turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives. The challenges span asynchronous workflows, isolated execution, extensible integrations, reliability, observability and cost control. The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality. Who You Are You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship. You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape. You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. title: AI-Enabled Governance Associate (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As our AI-Enabled Governance Associate, you will help strengthen how lemon.markets runs and improves governance processes across third-party management, partner oversight, and operational controls in a regulated environment. This role starts with a strong focus on third-party-related governance, including external providers, partners, and intra-group relationships. Over time, the scope can evolve further toward governance excellence, KPI/SLA monitoring, control effectiveness, and AI-supported process improvement. A core part of this role is to help us use AI and automation in a practical way across recurring governance workflows. This includes identifying repetitive manual work, improving how information is collected and assessed, making documentation and reporting more efficient, and helping turn process-heavy governance tasks into more scalable operating routines. In this role you will: Support and improve governance processes related to third parties, partners, and operational oversight in a regulated environment. Identify repetitive manual work and fragmented workflows, and improve them through better process design, standardisation, AI-supported execution, and selective automation. Use AI tools in a practical way to support analysis, information structuring, questionnaire handling, documentation drafting, summarisation, reporting support, and follow-up preparation. Work with internal subject-matter experts to better understand, improve, and scale KPI, SLA, and monitoring approaches across both internal services and third-party services. Help optimise KPI monitoring, service reporting, and governance transparency so operational performance becomes more measurable, decision-useful, and actionable. Contribute to making recurring governance work more scalable, consistent, and less manual over time. Support governance routines such as reviews, reporting, meeting preparation, action tracking, and evidence collection. Support assessments, reviews, and due diligence processes for new and existing providers or partners. Support governance documentation, registers, supporting evidence, and process transparency for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and relevant partners. You’ll be successful in this role if you: Are excited to learn how governance, controls, third-party processes, and operational oversight work in practic and the can be optimized, Have strong analytical skills and are comfortable structuring information, spotting gaps, and turning observations into practical next steps. Work in a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented way, with strong follow-up discipline. Bring a pragmatic, hands-on mindset and enjoy improving recurring processes rather than only designing concepts. Are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how they can help make operational and governance processes more efficient. Are motivated by the idea of reducing manual work through better workflows, smarter tooling, and selective automation. Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, service levels, incidents, monitoring concepts, and operational dependencies without needing to be an engineer. Communicate clearly in English and enjoy working with different stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions. German is a plus. Analyse strategic partnerships to enhance the data included in the product and its features. Work closely with partners and law firms to define data acquisition priorities and identify the most relevant and authoritative sources for each practice area. Take ownership of legal domains (e.g. civil, commercial, labour, privacy, banking), becoming the internal subject-matter reference and setting the quality standard for that area. WHO YOU ARE French law degree (Master 2 or equivalent). 3+ years of experience as a practicing lawyer, preferably in civil law. Fluent in French and English. A genuine desire to pursue an alternative and challenging career path outside traditional practice, in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment. Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail. Outstanding problem-solving skills. Clear communicator, comfortable acting as a "translator" between legal requirements and technical teams. Curiosity about AI and legal technology, and the drive to learn how LLMs and legal data work together (no prior technical/AI experience required). Strong plus: experience in Legal Engineering, Product or Program Management; master's in Law & Tech. WHAT SETS US APART An Exceptional Team At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI. Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results. You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth. Growth that Matters We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead. Your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field. Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you're ready to take responsibility, you'll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects. Rewarding Your Contribution Salary: €45,000–€60,000 gross per year, based on experience. Equity: an equity package, so you share in the company’s long-term success. We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.
