title: Quantum Applications Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects . Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured. Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods. This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research. Your Key Responsibilities Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems. Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches. Define meaningful benchmarks , including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches. Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications. Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact. Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept , working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project. Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle , including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners. Present technical work to customers and partners , explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences. Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams. Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python. What will make you successful You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one. What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore. You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications : scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers. Requirements You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms , combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications. You ideally bring: A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field , or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience. A first professional experience in a similar environment is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of quantum algorithms , particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers. Knowledge of NISQ algorithms and variational quantum algorithms . Good programming skills, particularly in Python . The ability to understand a complex industrial or scientific problem and translate it into a computational and algorithmic framework. A rigorous approach to benchmarking quantum and classical methods . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present technical topics directly to customers, partners and broader audiences. Professional proficiency in English . Previous experience working on customer-facing technical projects, quantum application projects, consulting, pre-sales, collaborative R&D projects or industrial partnerships would be a strong plus. Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira is appreciated but not essential. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A role at the intersection of cutting-edge quantum research and real-world industrial applications. Direct exposure to a wide variety of quantum computing use cases and industries. The opportunity to work with leading researchers, engineers, industrial partners and customers. Significant ownership in shaping Quandela's application portfolio and identifying the problems quantum computing should address next. The opportunity to work across the full quantum stack, from algorithms and software to Quandela's photonic quantum computing technology. A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely). We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. title: Technical Business Development Intern (Emerging Verticals) (f/m/d)
description: Description QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where. Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join Quantum Diamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Map and evaluate application areas for magnetic field imaging beyond semiconductors: key players, customer segments and structured comparisons of use cases. Review scientific literature and patents to understand the state of the art, competing measurement methods, and where NV-based imaging offers a real advantage. Prepare and join discovery conversations with researchers and companies to understand their measurement challenges, and keep contacts and opportunities up to date in our CRM. Support feasibility studies with our experts, from defining suitable samples to interpreting first measurement results. Turn your findings into clear deliverables such as application one-pagers, decision memos, and presentations. What is expected of you Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in physics, engineering, materials science, chemistry, biophysics, or a related natural science or engineering field, ideally with some Python exposure. Business studies or first experience in market research, consulting, or a startup is a plus, not required. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. title: Platform Architect - Banking
description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets. The role You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services. You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve. You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. What you will do - Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services. - Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services. - Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision. - Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation. - Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO. - Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met. - Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools. - Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible. - Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions. - Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope. - Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not. - Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect. - Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you. Essential experience - You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them. - You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance. - You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred. - You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code. - You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance. - You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery. - You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers. Nice to have - Delivery in financial services or banking. - LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A. - Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations. - Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry. Practical details - Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement. - You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client. title: Director, Sales (Nordics & Eastern Europe)
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. The Sales Director will be tasked with influencing and developing an energized, competitive, high impact sales team that is characterized by its ability to create differentiated value for our customer base. We're looking for a seasoned leader from within the SaaS enterprise marketplace, with proven software solution selling combined with success in a fast growth business. This leader will be a model to drive the team in building extraordinary customer relationships and experiences, leveraging a strong teamwork approach, and cross matrix collaboration across all Ping functions. This role will demonstrate a depth of understanding when working alongside a partner community and posess a well-established customer and partner network in the Nordics & Eastern Europe regions. In order to acquire, develop and retain customer relationships and create a winning Ping business, this leader will be able to create and maintain a high-performance culture, that is grounded in data, transparency, accountability, and agility. The ideal candidate's mindset should be customer-focused, people-oriented, open, passionate, and authentic. Responsibilities: Creates, implements, measures and reviews a strategic or operational plan that drives achievement of business goals aligned to overall Ping strategy Uses mechanisms such as territory planning, account plans, opportunity inspection, pipeline management, account reviews, forecast calls, etc. Advises and coaches the sales team around how to position and articulate Ping Identity's value proposition at enterprise customers, thus increasing the average deal size Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand business activities within areas of responsibility Leverages GSIs & other partners to help source, develop and progress business Plans and controls the expense associated with the area of responsibility even if not responsible for overall cost center Establishes working relationships with external parties which supports the achievement of business goals Is conversant with Ping Identity's systems and procedures and ensures effective use of and conformance to standard business practices and tools (i.e. SFDC – SalesForce.com) Communicates Ping Identity's vision and aligns team and personal goals to achieve business results Provides direction and guidance, mentoring and development of the field team Lives teamwork and promotes cross-functional collaboration Recruits, builds and develops the team to deliver business results; Identifies, develops and promotes high potential employees Recommends and/or approves people-related decisions – hiring, promotions, merit increases, rewards & recognition, training initiatives, etc. Drives performance review and development planning process with annual and quarterly review meetings Has established multi-vertical C level contacts in large enterprise customers Has an established partner/SI network and is used to working with partners on projects Builds relationships with customers (internal or external) as necessary providing customer escalation management as necessary for problem resolution Provides support for customer relationship management as necessary and drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience of successfully leading sales teams focused on the Nordics & Eastern Europe Expertise in enterprise software, SaaS, managed services and strategic account management Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota Flexibility to travel to across the regions Transitioned a team through on-prem to SaaS solutions Adept working in a fast-growing global organization Good interpersonal skills to align and foster positive working relationships across the organization Eligibility to work in the Netherlands or Norway Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Pourquoi Deliveroo ?</strong></p> <p>Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.</p> <p>Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.</p> <p><strong>Descriptif du poste :</strong></p> <p>En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à <strong>interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing </strong>tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’<strong>équipe commerciale. </strong></p> <p><strong>Vos missions consisteront à:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.</li> <li>Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.  </li> <li>Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).</li> <li>Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.</li> <li>Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).</li> <li>Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. </li> <li>Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales</li> </ul> <p>Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. </p> <p><strong>Ce qui vous permettra de réussir</strong></p> <p>Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.</p> <p><strong>Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais</li> <li>Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.</li> <li>Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.</li> <li>Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.</li> </ul> <p>Voici un<a href="https://sites.google.com/deliveroo.co.uk/biz-interview-guide/home?authuser=0"> lien</a> avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.</p> <p>Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !</p> <p><strong>La vie chez Deliveroo :</strong></p> <p>Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.</p> <p>Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.</p> <p><em>À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Director, Sales & Key Accounts, EMEA
description: <p><strong>Core skills: </strong>business development, new logo acquisition, strategic account management, cross-sell, video infrastructure, executive engagement, pipeline generation, enterprise closing.</p> <p><strong>Bitmovin</strong><strong> </strong>is an award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands and managed service providers. Our solution suite consists of Live and VOD Encoding, a Multi-Platform Player, and Analytics platform; enabling content owners to redefine the viewer experience through API-based workflow optimization, fast turnaround, and scalability. </p> <p>We have seen great success and created great momentum in the market. This is down to our products, ecosystem, but ultimately our people who love video streaming and helping customers.</p> <p><em>“We’re building the future of video streaming across EMEA - combining high-impact hunting with strategic account growth to deliver unmatched commercial results. If you’re ready to help shape the industry and make a real impact, join us.”</em><em><br></em><em> </em><em> </em>Barney Withers Green, SVP, Sales & Business Development, EMEA & APAC</p> <p>At <strong>Bitmovin</strong><strong> </strong>we value cognitive diversity and the huge part this plays in not only creating a global culture second to none, but in how this underpins our ability to create truly representative, Emmy award winning products. Diversity in all its forms is encouraged and celebrated at Bitmovin; everyone has a role to play in helping us shape the future of video.</p> <h3><strong>Why us? </strong></h3> <p><strong>Bitmovin</strong> is rapidly growing with significant market opportunity, and we are looking for talented and self driven individuals to take Bitmovin to the next level. </p> <p>Following an exciting evolution of our commercial structure, we are seeking an exceptional, commercially driven Sales Director to accelerate revenue growth, develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our presence across key EMEA markets.<br><br>This role uniquely combines high-impact new business development with strategic ownership of key customer relationships. Supported by designated Account Managers and Customer Success resources for day-to-day management, you will be empowered to focus on winning new logos, driving strategic cross-sell, and engaging executives across the region. With our full support and coaching, you will pave your own path, collaborating with our global teams to shape the future of media and streaming.</p> <p>This is an opportunity that offers:</p> <ul> <li>Opportunity to shape the streaming and video technology strategies of leading EMEA Media & Entertainment companies</li> <li>A hybrid role balancing high-velocity new business acquisition with strategic key account ownership</li> <li>Selling market-leading products (Live Encoding, VOD Encoding, Player, Observability) alongside top Cloud Partners and System Integrators</li> <li>Autonomy, international collaboration, flexible working, and regional travel (~50%). </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Impact</strong></h3> <p>As Director, Sales & Key Accounts, you will be at the forefront of powering the next generation of digital video across EMEA. Your mission is to fuel Bitmovin’s expansion by acquiring game-changing new logos and driving high-value strategic growth across priority markets, including the UK, DACH, and selected CEE & MENA regions.</p> <ul> <li>Operating within the global GTM and partner strategy to define and execute local initiatives in media, streaming, and OTT markets.</li> <li>Driving direct enterprise sales with full sales cycle ownership, including multi-year SaaS agreements and platform licensing deals.</li> <li>Enabling customers to adopt Bitmovin solutions in the way that best fits their business — direct, partner-led, or cloud/video platform routes.</li> <li>Identifying, onboarding, and enabling local partners to drive net-new revenue and new customer wins.</li> <li>Collaborating with local and global teams (solutions engineering, customer success, partner teams) to support adoption and partner success.</li> <li>Providing market insights, competitor intelligence, and recommendations on product, pricing, and GTM strategy.</li> <li>Tracking pipeline, revenue, and partner acquisition KPIs to measure impact and improve conversion rates across channels.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What competencies can you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Industry Expertise: </strong>Proven success selling software/technology into broadcasters, OTT platforms, or video infrastructure (CDN, adtech, broadcast tech)</li> <li><strong>Drive & Accountability: </strong>Track record of originating, closing complex enterprise sales, and consistently exceeding revenue goals</li> <li><strong>Relationship Building: </strong>Established network of technical and commercial decision-makers across EMEA media and streaming ecosystems</li> <li><strong>Technical Acumen: </strong>Solid grasp of streaming workflows, technical ecosystems, and enterprise buying processes</li> <li><strong>Proactive Ownership: </strong>Self-driven, highly autonomous pipeline builder focused on results and execution</li> <li><strong>Strategic Influence: </strong>Confident navigating high-value negotiations and engaging senior executive stakeholders</li> <li><strong>Collaboration & Adaptability: </strong>Open to feedback and skilled at partnering across cross-functional teams to drive collective success</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <p><strong>First 6 Months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish strong relationships with priority customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders</li> <li>Build a clear territory plan and strategic business development roadmaps for target regions</li> <li>Develop a healthy, self-generated pipeline of qualified opportunities</li> <li>Identify and progress strategic cross-sell opportunities within assigned key accounts</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 12 Months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver against agreed net-new ARR and strategic cross-sell targets</li> <li>Demonstrate consistent pipeline generation and enterprise deal progression</li> <li>Establish meaningful new customer relationships across priority EMEA markets</li> <li>Maintain strong executive engagement and strategic oversight of assigned key accounts</li> <li>Operate independently with rigorous forecasting discipline and commercial accountability</li> </ul> <p>You don’t have experience with all the points above? Don’t worry, we will support you with learning, training, and coaching on the job.</p> <h3><strong>Life at Bitmovin</strong></h3> <p>Find out more about us on our<a href="https://bitmovin.com/careers/"> Careers Page<br></a>See what fellow Bitmovers are saying on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/bitmovin/life/7f143265-8cc2-4ae8-93f4-dc88cf00d0d4/?viewAsMember=true"> LinkedIn<br></a>Check the employee reviews on<a href="https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Reviews/Bitmovin-Reviews-E1400248.htm"> Glassdoor</a></p> <p>For all of our roles, we are willing to discuss flexible working arrangements to support everyone’s unique circumstances.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require a Senior Electrical Engineer with deep electrical system design experience to architect and deliver critical systems and sub-systems. The Senior Electrical Engineer strives to leverage their experience with Electrical and Power Systems to rapidly architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.<br><br><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the development and design of innovative electrical systems and products that meet the unique requirements of our company.</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineers and team members to integrate electrical systems into larger product designs</li> <li>Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business objectives into clear electrical engineering deliverables.</li> <li>Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, test procedures, and technical reports.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and safety requirements throughout the product development lifecycle.</li> <li>Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and testing to evaluate system performance and optimise efficiency.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex electrical engineering challenges and provide innovative and practical solutions in a rapid development environment.</li> <li>Hold and deliver to project timelines, milestones, managing your time and budgets to achieve successful project outcomes.</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in electrical engineering and proactively apply new knowledge to improve our products.</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.</li> <li>Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch.</li> <li>Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions.</li> <li>Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.</li> <li>Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.</li> <li>Passion for technology and a curiosity to stay updated with the latest advancements in the industry.</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance (NV2).</li> </ul> <h3>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles.</li> <li>Experience in the subsea or maritime domain</li> <li>Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. </span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p> </p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.</p> </div> <div class="RichText column2"> <p class="detailElios">To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:</p> <ul> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>No Financial Requests: </strong>Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. title: Senior Privacy Counsel, Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>As part of Waymo's Legal team, you will work on the exciting legal issues surrounding our transformational autonomous driving technology and help drive our business lines forward from technology ideation through scaled commercial deployment. We partner with our public policy, safety, security and privacy experts to define transportation policy for the autonomous driving world to come, advising on regulatory changes that support and protect our users around the world. We collaborate with our engineering, product, strategy and operations teams to develop and protect our intellectual property portfolio and drive our corporate and commercial transactions. We ensure compliance with an increasingly complex and dynamic range of global regulations. And we anticipate, mitigate, and litigate high-profile and precedent-setting legal matters.</p> <p><em>In this hybrid role, you will report into our Managing Counsel. </em></p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary, on-the-ground Privacy Counsel for Waymo's operations, product launches, and engineering initiatives across Germany and the broader EU, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure compliance with GDPR, ePrivacy, and local laws like the BDSG.</li> <li>Advise on "Privacy by Design" and data minimization principles for European market entry, working directly with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to design innovative privacy solutions for complex sensor data and model training.    </li> <li>Proactively build and maintain constructive title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent Your responsibilities Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down. Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy. Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it. Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently. Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale. About you Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus. Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling. The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team. A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job. Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases. Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows. Iterate for Impact Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI. Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements. Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices. 5. Drive Adoption & Enablement Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers. Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations. Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company. Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><div class="flex h-svh w-screen flex-col"> <h2 class="relative z-0 flex min-h-0 w-full flex-1">The role</h2> <p>The YDB Development Team at Nebius is hiring mid- and senior-level software developers with C++ expertise.<br><br><strong>YDB is an open-source platform with two roles within Nebius:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Providing the binary object storage foundation for S3 Object Storage, Shared Filesystems and Network Block Storage</li> <li>Serving as a distributed relational database and message broker for services such as IAM, billing, audit trails and logging</li> </ul> <p>We operate YDB clusters in more than 10 regions using HDD and NVMe storage. Individual clusters span tens of thousands of nodes, manage hundreds of petabytes of data and deliver terabytes per second of throughput. Our infrastructure includes x86 and Arm-based systems, including NVIDIA GB300 nodes.</p> <div> <p><strong>What you’ll work on</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evolve YDB’s architecture for new hardware, redesigning core components when incremental optimization is insufficient: <ul> <li>QLC NVMe drives: increase storage density while controlling RAM/CPU consumption and write amplification</li> <li>Dual 800 Gb/s network adapters: reduce CPU overhead and memory bandwidth consumption to utilize the available NIC bandwidth</li> <li>NVIDIA GB300-based systems: ensure efficient operation on Arm-based hosts and offload storage and networking processing to BlueField DPUs</li> </ul> </li> <li>Support high-capacity SMR HDDs by designing data placement, sequential writes, garbage collection and recovery around zoned-write constraints</li> <li>Develop wide erasure-coding schemes to reduce space aplimfication while maintaining durability and availability</li> <li>Reduce recovery and rebalancing times after device outages while limiting the impact on foreground workloads</li> <li>Prevent, detect and recover from silent data corruption across memory, networking and storage</li> <li>Provide the system capabilities and interfaces required by fleet-wide automation so that hundreds of production clusters can be deployed, configured, upgraded, diagnosed and operated consistently</li> </ul> <p>We move quickly and focus on delivering practical value. Features and optimizations merged into the production branch are typically deployed within weeks. You’ll see your work solving real problems in live clusters—not waiting years to make an impact.</p> <p><br><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience developing high-load systems in C or C++. Candidates with 3+ years will also be considered if their experience includes relevant work on distributed storage systems</li> <li>Experience developing high-performance, low-latency software components</li> <li>Understanding of core dumps, flame graphs and sanitizer-enabled builds</li> <li>Understanding of CPU caches, atomic operations and NUMA architectures</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing and developing production-grade distributed storage systems and/or databases</li> <li>Experience with on-disk data structures such as LSM trees and B+ trees, and storage algorithms such as erasure coding and checksumming</li> <li>Understanding of NVMe, conventional HDD and SMR HDD internals</li> <li>Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, VTune, bpftrace and gdb</li> <li>Familiarity with the Linux kernel, SPDK/DPDK, libaio and io_uring</li> <li>Knowledge of IP, TCP, UDP and DNS, and ideally InfiniBand or RoCE/RDMA</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes and Grafana</li> <li>Experience responding to production incidents</li> <li>Knowledge of availability and durability calculations<br><br></li> </ul> <p>For <strong>Senior candidates</strong>, we offer hybrid working or the flexibility to work remotely within EU.</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.</p> <p>You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.</li> <li>Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe.</li> <li>Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.</li> </ul><div title: Customer Service Specialist (m/w/d) Telefonservice
description: Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Als Customer Service Specialist (m/w/d) Telefonservice bist du eine der ersten Stimmen, die unsere Kundinnen und Kunden hören. Du sorgst für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und einen professionellen ersten Eindruck – und stellst sicher, dass sich unsere Kund:innen jederzeit gut aufgehoben fühlen. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und unseren technischen Teams zusammen und trägst maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben Entgegennahme und Bearbeitung eingehender Kundenanrufe als zentraler, telefonischer Erstkontakt. Aktive Nachverfolgung von Kundenanliegen per Rückruf (Outbound), wenn eine Klärung es erfordert. Direkte, strukturierte Lösung von Anliegen am Telefon – von allgemeinen Fragen bis zu spezifischen Problemen. Einhaltung von Service-Levels (Erreichbarkeit, Anrufannahme, Bearbeitungszeit) mit klaren Zielwerten. Lückenlose Dokumentation jedes Gesprächs im CRM-System direkt im Anschluss an den Call. Enge Abstimmung mit Sales, Marketing und technischen Berater:innen zur Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit. Mitwirkung an der Optimierung von Gesprächsleitfäden, Skripten und Telefonie-Prozessen. Dein Profil Erfahrung im telefonischen Kundenkontakt, z. B. im Kundenservice, Inside Sales, Vertrieb oder in der Bestandskundenbetreuung. Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools. Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2). Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: Methodical Thinker: Du arbeitest strukturiert, datenbasiert und lösungsorientiert und gehst Prioritäten ruhig und systematisch an. Proactive Problem Solver: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Lösungen, denkst einen Schritt weiter und hilfst dabei, Probleme nachhaltig zu vermeiden. Clear Communicator: Du erklärst auch komplexe Themen klar, verständlich und verbindlich am Telefon – und bleibst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän. Customer Oriented: Du versetzt dich in die Situation unserer Kund:innen, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und findest zügig passende Lösungen. Quick Learner: Du eignest dir neue Produkte, Prozesse und Technologien schnell an und hast Freude daran, dazuzulernen – auch im Zusammenspiel mit internen Abläufen und Kundensystemen. Benefits Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. title: Account Executive - Mid-market - €60–80K + BSPCE
description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Context Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch. We are scaling fast: our target is €1M of signed ARR per month by the end of December 2026. The liberal segment (private practices and groups, ~€10–30k ARR per account) needs to contribute heavily. This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory. Your mission Generate €400k ARR in year one in new business on the liberal segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals. Expected outcomes 1 month: Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…) Make your first prospecting calls , demos , and initial sales conversations Close your first simple deals independently. 3 months: Build a stable pipeline , with at least 30 active opportunities at different stages Improve our call scripts and email sequences Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification 6-12 months: Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders) Contribute to structuring our sales playbook Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings) What the role looks like day to day Build your own pipeline Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one Own the full sales cycle Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with practice and group decision-makers Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments (~1 month post-signature) Make the engine better Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences What sales look like on the liberal segment Deal size from 15K to 30K 1 month sale cycle ICP : group of independent practitioners This role is for you if The prerequisites: You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets : people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers. You've run SMB/mid deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 6 months, on fast, slightly pushy cycles (€10–20k average basket). You listen actively, you're convincing and assertive, and you're comfortable being pushy. You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with doctors: they need to be won over, so we want sharp closers. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to individual practitioners with the same professional posture. What we'll evaluate in interviews: Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego : you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet. Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work. Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable. Requirements: 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company Entrepreneurial mindset Nice to have: Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals) Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo This role is NOT for you if You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only "sold" by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch. You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes. Perks and Benefits Equity (BSPCE) Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays). Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote. MacBook provided. Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company). EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib). Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered. Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered. Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year. Hiring process Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE) Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team Reference checks Offer We aim to keep the process within 30 days . You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout. Why should you join Vocca? An entrepreneurial adventure , with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team A product already live , with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI) A true scaling phase , with everything still to build Real responsibilities from day one We hire people, not roles. If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? We'll be thrilled to receive your application! title: Chef.fe de Projet Hôpitaux / Project Manager Hospital
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement. Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. title: Account Executive, Enterprise, Asset Management
description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview Harvey is the AI platform trusted by the world's leading law firms and corporate legal teams, and one of the fastest-growing companies in AI. Now we're bringing that to asset management — and this role owns it. We're building the team that will define how the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, and institutional funds adopt AI. This is a ground-floor opportunity to own a new vertical — we're still proving out this motion, which means the person who joins will help write the playbook. What You'll Do Develop and manage a named account list across asset management — private equity, venture, private credit, hedge funds, real assets, and institutional allocators (LPs) — and own the full sales cycle from prospecting through contracting and expansion. Build and manage senior relationships across each firm's legal, compliance, and investment teams — typically anchored by a GC, CLO, or CCO — expanding into portfolio-company counsel over time. Understand how decisions get made in these organizations and navigate accordingly. Lead complex, multi-threaded deals with stakeholders ranging from managing directors and general partners to day-to-day legal and compliance users — translating Harvey's AI capabilities into language that resonates with financial buyers. Work closely with product and engineering to stay current on Harvey's capabilities and shape solutions around how asset managers actually work — contract review, due diligence, portfolio company support, regulatory workflows. Conduct tailored demos and presentations that connect Harvey's product directly to the workflows and pain points specific to financial services buyers. Document what works. This team is building the asset management playbook from scratch, and your learnings will directly shape how we scale the motion. What You Have Experience selling complex software or professional services into financial services (ideally asset management, private equity, or institutional funds). You understand how these firms are structured and how buying decisions get made. Proven ability to run a global or named account relationship — you've been the person a firm calls, not just the person who closes a deal and moves on. Ideally you've navigated a fund relationship or portfolio company motion. Background in enterprise software sales, management consulting, or a combination — we're intentionally mixing profiles on this team. If you've unlocked a major financial services account or come from a firm that advises these organizations, we want to talk to you. Comfortable operating in a motion that's still being defined. You're a builder who can prospect independently, iterate on messaging, and contribute to the team's collective learning. Genuine curiosity about AI and how it applies to knowledge-intensive work. You don't need a legal background, but you should be excited about what Harvey is doing and motivated to develop real fluency in the space.
