title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
description: Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career? At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit. We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle. Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you. We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026 , giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu. You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients. Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home. Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters. Opportunities Available We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry. Pharmacy Assistant An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required. You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently. We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity. No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team. You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety. Pharmacy Dispenser For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment. You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team. You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes. Accuracy Checking Dispenser We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy. You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team. Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT) For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration. You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards. You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment. What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre? We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do. That is why we are taking a slightly different approach. Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment. You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including: Attention to detail and accuracy Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions Working effectively with others Organisation and the ability to follow processes Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy Communication and problem-solving We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities. We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment. What happens after the assessment centre? Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date. Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment. What Are We Looking For? We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference. Our ideal candidates will be: Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service. Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication. Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic. Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you. Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together. Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change. Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills. You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here. What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly. About Montu Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK. Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care. We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do. Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey. We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey. Why Join Montu? Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference. We offer: Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience Opportunities for training and professional development Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations A supportive and collaborative team environment The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process. Ready to Join Us? Assessment Centre: Monday 2 November 2026 Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre. Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day. title: Prescriptions Coordinator
description: At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Administrator to join our Operations team at Winnersh Triangle. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference. With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK. About the Role As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey. Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions. This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care. What You Will Be Doing Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information. Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays. Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions. Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly. Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need. Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required. Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures. Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed. Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians. Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better. Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training. Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required. Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required. What You Will Need At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role. Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner. A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others. Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures. A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service. What We Offer Competitive salary 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays 5% matched pension contribution Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Cycle-to-work scheme Opportunities for professional development and career progression The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued About Montu Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care. As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK. Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support. Compensation: £29.5K • £29.5K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The market is growing by 20% every year , fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act . We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us. Deine Mission bei Kertos Mit deiner Expertise im Bereich Informationssicherheit wirst du ein essentieller Teil unseres Teams. Du bringst dein Fachwissen bei der Betreuung und Beratung unserer Kunden ein und wirkst intern als Architekt*in unserer Prozesse mit, um sie skalierbar zu machen. Unsere Vision ist es Europas führende Compliance Automatisierungslösung zu werden - dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung! Werde Teil unseres Teams in dieser spannenden Wachstumsphase und transformiere die Compliance-Welt mit uns. Du gestaltest unsere internen Prozesse mit, damit sie mit unserem Unternehmen und den Kundenanforderungen wachsen können. title: Product & Tech | Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - AI & Data
description: Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact. Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution. We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where everyone is expected to think critically, take ownership early and work directly with senior stakeholders. What you will do As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build and deploy AI, data and software solutions directly with our clients. You are an engineer first: you write production code and take technical ownership of complex projects from discovery through production and handover. You will work with client teams, alongside Singulier engineers, Product Owners, delivery managers and advisory colleagues: Build and ship: write, review and debug production code. Build applications, integrations, data pipelines and AI workflows or agents that connect models to client data, tools and processes. Design the solution: translate business priorities into architecture, technical scope and estimates, and make explicit trade-offs between quality, cost and speed. Run it in production: put in place testing, AI evaluations, access controls, monitoring and deployment suited to the client's systems and constraints. Drive adoption: understand workflows, test assumptions with users and explain technical choices to engineers and executives. Agree success measures upfront, track adoption and business impact, and hand over with documentation and training. Lead technically: guide other engineers through design and debugging, coordinate technical dependencies, and turn project work into reusable components and patterns. This is a senior individual contributor role. Beyond client work, you will help build the firm: scoping and estimating new projects, interviewing engineering candidates, and contributing to internal AI initiatives and experimentation. Work environment : engineering culture and stack We are building a small, highly skilled delivery team that shares engineering patterns and goes deep on a focused stack. Our aim is to make AI and technology transformation practical for mid-sized companies, within their budgets, teams and operating realities. Reusing proven foundations across projects lets us deliver faster, with consistent quality and a clear path to business value. The stack below is our default, not a constraint: we adapt to client environments and adopt new tools when the benefit is clear. Ways of working: Git, pull requests, code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD. Monitoring, evaluations and tracing ship with every AI application. Languages and frameworks: Python, SQL and TypeScript; Polars, FastAPI, Pydantic and Pydantic AI. Data: PostgreSQL, DuckDB, LanceDB and Parquet, with attention to data quality, modelling and the simplest design that meets performance and scale needs. Infrastructure: infrastructure as code, Docker, and disciplined configuration, secrets and environment management. Databricks and Google Cloud, including BigQuery, when the workload calls for them. You do not need to have used every tool listed. We care about what you have shipped, how you collaborate and what production has taught you. Requirements You will likely bring: 6+ years as a hands-on engineer in software, data or applied AI, including technical ownership of complex production deployments. description: Location : Lyon, France About ARCHIMED: With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and avai

<p><strong>Investor engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support day-to-day engagement with sell-side analysts and institutional investors, including responding to inbound requests and maintaining our investor database.</li> <li>Help plan and run investor events, including sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and non-deal roadshows.</li> <li>Prepare briefing materials for the CEO, CFO, and other executives ahead of investor meetings, including investor profiles, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Maintain core IR collateral, including the investor presentation, fact sheets, and IR website content.</li> <li>Analyze shareholder ownership and support investor targeting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and strategic finance projects</strong></p> <ul> finance projects such as peer benchmarking, competitive analyses, long-range financial modeling, and ad-hoc analyses for senior leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytics and tooling</strong></p> This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

title: Developer GTM Strategy Manager, Technical Programs

Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and feedback loops for technical services offerings.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and launch new technical programs:</strong> Lead high-priority projects across Developer GTM, support team planning and process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of projects this person may own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a proactive SA/FDE engagement program for a priority customer segment or product motion.</li> <li>Partner on an account propensity model that helps determine SA/FDE prioritization, resourcing, and account coverage.</li> <li>Stand up a technical engagement tracker for active customer work, resourcing, blockers, and outcomes.</li> <li>Design the planning and follow-up model for technical onsite visits with strategic customers.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to package a repeatable services motion and build the business case for rollout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solutions Architects and FDEs have a clearer operating model for proactive programs and strategic customer engagements.</li> <li>Leadership has a reliable view of technical revenue pipeline, engagement health, account propensity, and investment ROI.</li> <li>Strategic customer initiatives and technical onsite visits move faster because goals, staffing, owners, success criteria, and follow-up are clear.</li> <li>Professional Services offerings are easier to understand, price, package, and align to Cloudflare's broader consumption-led strategy.</li> <li>New technical GTM motions move from ambiguous ideas to measurable programs with durable owners.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, technical program management, solutions strategy, consulting, or a similar cross-functional execution role.</li> <li>Experience working with technical customer-facing teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Developer Relations, or Product.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency, including the ability to understand customer architecture discussions, implementation tradeoffs, developer platform concepts, and the operating needs of technical GTM teams.</li> <li>Strong program management ability, including managing complex work streams, driving accountability without direct authority, and keeping teams aligned under pressure.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership; someone who takes initiative, works independently, and manages time effectively.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Highly customer-centric, with natural curiosity about technical products and a strategic mindset for solving complex problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working under pressure and adjusting priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including comfort using spreadsheets, CRM data, and business dashboards to prioritize work and inform decisions.</li> <li>Prior experience with Salesforce CRM, Tableau, BigQuery, or BoostUp is a plus.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) is a strong plus.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $161,000 - In this high-energy, hunter role, your primary mission is new logo acquisition — finding, engaging, and closing net-new digital-native companies across the region who are not yet working with Cloudflare. Your target universe includes fintechs, SaaS platforms, AI-native startups, developer-led scale-ups, and cloud-first businesses: companies that move fast, make infrastructure decisions at the engineering level, and expect their vendors to keep up. The ideal candidate understands how digital-native companies actually buy — bottom-up product adoption, engineering influence, founder-driven decisions, and rapid procurement — and engages as a credible peer in conversations with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical founders.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">As a Digital Natives Account Executive, you will build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, and ecosystem presence, convert developer-led adoption into commercial new logo wins, and position Cloudflare as the infrastructure partner of choice for the next generation of technology companies. Critically, you will use AI tools as an active and integral part of how you sell — both because your buyers, who are often building AI products themselves, will notice and respect it, and because winning new logos at pace in this segment requires it. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you are expected to leverage AI tools daily as a genuine force multiplier across your prospecting, pipeline, and preparation — not as an occasional aid.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>New Logo Acquisition:</strong> Drive the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new digital-native accounts as the primary focus of this role. Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, VC and accelerator networks, partner channels, and product-led adoption signals. Consistently bring new customers onto the Cloudflare platform and exceed new logo targets each quarter.</li> <li><strong>Outbound & Ecosystem-Led Pipeline Generation: </strong>Take full ownership of pipeline creation — through direct outreach, active participation in the startup and tech ecosystem, and engagement with founder and developer communities across DACH. Identify buying signals early and move quickly to engage the right stakeholders at the right moment.</li> <li><strong>Developer & Technical Buyer Engagement:</strong> Build credible, trusted relationships with technically sophisticated buyers — CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads, and technical founders. Engage with genuine fluency on infrastructure, APIs, developer experience, cloud architecture, and security — translating Cloudflare's capabilities into outcomes that matter to people who build things.</li> <li><strong>Product-Led Growth Conversion: </strong>Identify accounts where individual or team-level usage of Cloudflare's platform signals a commercial opportunity. Convert that adoption into formalised new logo wins by engaging the right stakeholders with the right narrative at the right time, before a competitor does.</li> <li><strong>AI Platform Positioning: </strong>Position Cloudflare's AI infrastructure capabilities — AI Gateway, Workers AI, Vectorize, and Zero Trust for AI workloads — to prospects building AI-powered products and services. Understand the real challenges your customers face around securing AI APIs, managing inference at scale, and controlling AI infrastructure costs, and articulate how Cloudflare addresses them in a way that resonates with technical buyers.</li> <li><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you prospect and sell — applying them to target account research, personalised outreach at scale, technical meeting preparation, pipeline management, and follow-up drafting. Your buyers are often building AI products; your workflow should reflect the same standard. Demonstrated AI fluency is a genuine expectation of this role, and you will be asked to speak specifically to how you use AI to improve your performance.</li> <li><strong>Full-Cycle Sales Management:</strong> Run efficient, full-cycle sales processes across a diverse prospect portfolio with varying deal sizes and cycle lengths. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.</li> <li>Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. Lead with the "why," communicating the full picture to both technical and commercial stakeholders at every stage of the sales cycle.</li> <li><strong>Post-Close Positioning: </strong>Ensure newly closed customers are set up for success on the Cloudflare platform and positioned for long-term growth. title: Director, Global Design & Construction
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Ensure Physical Security, IT, Legal, and Workplace leadership are deeply aligned under a unified, technology-supported project pipeline and data layer that prioritizes the employee experience.</li> <li><strong>Lifecycle Handover & Commissioning:</strong> Establish rigorous commissioning protocols to ensure flawless handovers from construction completion to local Workplace Operations  teams.</li> <li><strong>Global Pipeline Governance & Compliance:</strong> Oversee a global project pipeline across all international hubs and time zones, seamlessly balancing highly creative local refreshes with complex, large-scale 100,000+ square foot tenant improvement projects. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Hardware Integration Operations sits at the heart of this engine, bridging the gap between hardware engineering design, global supply chains, and data center deployment. You will manage employees across supply-chain operations, rack integration engineering, and technical program management while scaling the team’s capabilities.</p> <p>You will own the team’s day-to-day execution and operating model, ensuring L11 rack builds have the materials, technical requirements, supplier capacity, and deployment readiness needed to support Cloudflare’s infrastructure plans. You will also develop long-term strategy, including scaling global integration capacity, improving rack lifecycle operations, expanding integration capabilities, and influencing data center standards that enable greater use of rack integration.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on operational engagement. new rack architectures and L11 new product introductions in partnership with Hardware Engineering and Infrastructure Operations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Govern BOM consistency and integration test requirements while influencing structured cabling and data center standards that enable deployment-ready racks.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Lead Suppliers and Commercial Operations</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Drive relationships with global L11 integration suppliers, including performance reviews, capacity commitments, and escalations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Hardware Sourcing on regional expansion, commercial negotiations, and L11 operating-budget governance.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Expand Rack Integration Capabilities</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and scale programs that increase the range of work automation to improve operational efficiency, decision quality, and executive reporting.</p> </li> </ul> <p>What You Bring (Required Qualifications)</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>People external contract manufacturers (CMs), ODMs, or global suppliers.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Domain Technical Depth:</strong> Operational knowledge of rack-level server, network, power, cabling, and manufacturing considerations sufficient to guide technical specialists, challenge assumptions, and make informed operational decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Supplier & Program Governance:</strong> Demonstrated success managing supplier performance, capacity escalations, commercial reviews, and complex cross-functional programs spanning engineering, procurement, and logistics.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Process & Financial Acumen:</strong> Strong judgment in managing operational budgets, demand forecasts, production metrics, and cross-functional process development.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Global Collaboration & Travel:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across global time zones and travel periodically for supplier reviews.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualifications</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with hyperscale data center deployment readiness, colocation description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> <li>European Cloudflare Hubs</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.</p> <p>The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.</p> <p>We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.</li> <li>Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community.</li> <li>Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards.</li> <li>Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements.</li> <li>Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together.</li> <li>A track record of upstream Linux contribution, ideally including maintainership or sustained work in MM or an adjacent subsystem.</li> <li>Strong systems programming in C, with the judgement to make high-risk changes to shared infrastructure safely.</li> <li>Ability to dive deep into a complex codebase while keeping the fleet-wide picture in mind, and to own a problem and its outcome rather than a single patch.</li> <li>Clear communication with engineers across many teams, since the symptoms of an MM problem usually show up far from the MM code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonuses</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals pertaining to memory management</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment
