balance technical excellence with business impact</li> <li>Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Product adoption and business impact</li> <li>Performance and reliability of AI systems</li> <li>Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll Love This Job If you have </strong></h2> <ul> performance</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products</li> </ul> <p>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!</p> <h2><strong>Want to join us? We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong> We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above & Beyond:</strong>  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy & Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the job</strong></h2> <p>Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.<br><br>You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.</p> <p>This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.</p> <p><em> </em></p> <h2><strong>Why Now, Why Mirakl</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.</p> <p>At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.</p> <p>You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.</p> <h2><strong><br>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h4><strong>1. Design & Build AI Systems</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.</li> <li>Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.</li> <li>Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.</li> <li>Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Integrate Across the Stack</strong></p> <ul> <li>Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.</li> <li>Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.</li> <li>Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.</li> <li>Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Iterate for Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.</li> <li>Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.</li> <li>Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.</li> <li>Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.</li> <li>Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.</li> <li>Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>5. Drive Adoption & Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.</li> <li>Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.</li> <li>Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.</li> <li>Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our stack and tools</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>Python and SQL</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>AI Stack: </strong>OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Agentic & Retrieval: </strong>LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases</p> </li> <li><strong>Infrastructure: </strong>AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Makes You Successful</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems</li> <li>Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products</li> <li>Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact</li> <li>Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Product adoption and business impact</li> <li>Performance and reliability of AI systems</li> <li>Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll Love This Job If you have </strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields</li> <li>Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals</li> <li>Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents</li> <li>Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems</li> <li>Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products</li> </ul> <p>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!</p> <h2><strong>Want to join us? Here is our process </strong></h2> <ul> <li>A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.</li> <li>An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.</li> <li>2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French. </em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

La maitrise de Première Pro/After Affect est un plus.</li> <li>Maitrise des principales plateformes sociales / analytics </li> <li>Connaissance du secteur musical </li> <li>Organisé, rigoureux, curieux, analytique</li> <li>Première expérience en label et/ou agence créa/digitale serait un plus. </li> </ul> <p><strong>En intégrant Sony Music vous pourrez profiter de plusieurs avantages :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une Carte restaurant prise en charge à 60 %</li> <li>Des fruits frais sont mis à disposition trois fois par semaine</li> <li>Bénéficiez d’un parking pour votre vélo tout au long de l’année</li> <li>Accédez au forfait mobilité durable à hauteur 500 €/année complète</li> <li>Un programme de bien-être « massages ou ostéo »</li> <li>Town hall avec petits déjeuners</li> <li>Accès à une plateforme de santé mentale et de bien-être qui permet de parler à un psychologue expérimenté<br></li> <li>Des chèques vacances et carte cadeau de Noël offerts par le CSE</li> <li>Rejoindre Sony Music c’est également l’opportunité de participer à des events tels que la Summer et la Christmas Party</li> </ul> <p><strong>Durée, lieu et période du stage :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Durée : 6 mois (avec convention de stage obligatoire), stage à temps complet (35h/semaine)</li> <li>Début : Janvier 2026</li> <li>Lieu : 67/69 boulevard de Charonne 75011 PARIS</li> </ul> <p><strong>Indemnités de stage</strong> :</p> <ul> <li>Minimum légal (693€ bruts par mois) + Remboursement à 50% des frais de transport + Titres restaurant</li> </ul> <p>Vous vous reconnaissez à travers ce profil et l’aventure Sony Music Entertainment France vous tente ? title: Senior Portfolio Solution Engineer, Actimize
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>NiCE Actimize, the industry's largest and broadest provider of financial crime, anti-money laundering, enterprise fraud and compliance solutions is the leader in Autonomous Financial Crime Management. NiCE Actimize drives the Autonomous journey with ActOne for investigation and case management, as well as X-Sight, a cloud-based Financial Crime Risk Management Platform-as-a-Service. title: Praktikant/in, Life Sciences Strategieberatung/Life Sciences Intern (2027 Start) - m/f/d
description: <p><em>NOTE: English translation appears below</em></p> <p><strong>Über Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong>Charles River Associates</strong> ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.</p> <p><strong>Stellenübersicht</strong></p> <p>Die <strong>Life Sciences Practice</strong> von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.</p> <p>Unsere spezialisierte Life Sciences Practice bringt Klarheit und Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen. Kunden wenden sich an uns, wenn sie die richtige Entscheidung treffen, sie richtig umsetzen und die Zustimmung der wichtigsten Interessengruppen sichern müssen. Ihr Vertrauen in uns beruht auf unserem emphatischen Fokus auf die Kunden und insbesondere auf unserer praktischen Erfahrung in den Life Sciences, unserem tiefgehenden Industriewissen von der Forschung und Entwicklung bis zum Markteintritt und darüber hinaus sowie unseren starken akademischen Qualifikationen in den Bereichen Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Betriebswirtschaft.</p> <p>Das Life Sciences Team von CRA arbeitet von Büros in den USA und Europa aus, um Einblicke in globale Themen und lokale Marktchancen zu bieten und unseren Kunden einen einfachen Zugang zu ermöglichen.</p> <p>Der Einstieg in die Life Sciences Practice bei CRA bietet Ihnen eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen über das Gesundheitswesen weltweit zu erweitern. Unser Praktikumsprogramm soll die Analystenerfahrung widerspiegeln und Ihnen ein besseres Verständnis für unser Geschäft und die Art der Arbeit bei Charles River Associates vermitteln.</p> <p><strong>Aufgaben</strong></p> <p>Praktikanten sind neugierige und analytische Denker, die kreative Ansätze für nicht standardisierte Probleme mitbringen. Sie werden Teil eines integrierten Teams sein, das eine Vielzahl von Beratungsprojekten durchführt und liefert. Typische Aufgaben sind:</p> <ul> <li>Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kollegen zur Durchführung von Strategie- und/oder Politik- und Wirtschaftsberatungsprojekten, die spezifische Kundenbedürfnisse adressieren;</li> <li>Unterstützung bei unabhängigen Recherchen zur Identifizierung, Sammlung, Verwaltung und Analyse qualitativer Erkenntnisse und quantitativer Daten;</li> <li>Beitrag zu internen Diskussionen, die Erkenntnisse aus dem Analyseprozess aufbauen und Ergebnisse in breitere Projektlieferungen integrieren;</li> <li>Teilnahme an Telefon- oder persönlichen Interviews mit Kunden oder externen Interessengruppen;</li> <li>Erstellung von Abschnitten von Kundenberichten, Präsentationen und anderen Kundenlieferungen (z.B. Excel-Arbeitsmappen) unter der Aufsicht von erfahrenen Teammitgliedern;</li> <li>Proaktive Entwicklung von Wissen über die Life-Sciences-Branche sowie Beratungsmethoden;</li> <li>Teilnahme an praxisbezogenen Aktivitäten (Schulungen, Wissensaustausch usw.).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Gewünschte Qualifikationen</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor-, Master- oder PhD-Studenten mit starker akademischer Leistung von einer erstklassigen Institution mit Schwerpunkt auf Biowissenschaften, Wirtschaft (oder verwandten Fächern wie Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie und -politik, öffentliche Politik), Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Ingenieurwesen oder einer anderen quantitativen Disziplin;</li> <li>Kenntnisse in der Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook und Excel) sowie Verständnis für Internetrecherchen</li> <li>Erfahrung in oder starkes Interesse an der Life-Sciences-Branche und dem Gesundheitswesen;</li> <li>Verständnis wirtschaftlicher Konzepte und Geschäftsprozesse sowie Vertrautheit mit wesentlichen Beratungsmethoden, -werkzeugen und -techniken ist sehr hilfreich;</li> <li>Effektive schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil);</li> <li>Starke Selbstmanagementfähigkeiten (Detailorientierung, effektives Zeitmanagement, Fähigkeit zur Priorisierung);</li> <li>Nachgewiesenes hohes Maß an Initiative und Führung;</li> <li>Hervorragende Teamarbeit und Kollaboration;</li> <li>Klares und nachgewiesenes Interesse an Beratung durch Kursarbeit, Arbeitserfahrung, Aktivitäten oder Teilnahme an CRA-Rekrutierungsveranstaltungen;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bewerbung</strong></p> <p><span data-teams="true">Bewerbungen werden fortlaufend geprüft. Die Dauer des Praktikums beträgt in der Regel vier bis sechs Monate, mit flexiblen Startterminen über das Jahr verteilt. Das Praktikum ist bezahlt, und wir freuen uns über Bewerber, die ab <strong>Mai 2027</strong> starten können. Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:</span></p> <ul> <li>Lebenslauf – maximal 1 Seite;</li> <li>Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt. Ihr Anschreiben sollte nicht länger als eine Seite sein und klar sowie professionell präsentiert werden (Mindestschriftgröße 12). Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Anschreiben die folgenden Fragen beantwortet: <ul> <li>Warum Life-Sciences-Consulting und warum CRA?</li> <li>Bitte beschreiben Sie ein Beispiel einer datenbasierte Entscheidung die Sie getroffen haben</li> <li>Welche Erfahrung aus Ihrem Lebenslauf/CV macht Sie am meisten stolz und warum?</li> </ul> </li> <li>Praktikumsbeginn und – dauer – bitte geben Sie ihr bevorzugtes Anfangsdatum (in 2027) und ihre bevorzugte Praktikumsdauer (4-6 Monate) an</li> </ul> <p><strong>Berufliche Entwicklung</strong></p> <p>Die robusten Entwicklungsprogramme und Wellness-Programme von CRA ermöglichen es Ihnene, sowohl als Individuum als auch als Teammitglied zu wachsen. Wir bieten Praktikanten eine Vielzahl von technischen Schulungen, Präsentationsfähigkeiten, internen Seminaren und Leistungscoaching.</p> <p><strong>Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz</strong></p> <p>CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Des weiteren bitten wir Praktikanten 5 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten. Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.</p> <p><strong>Unser Engagement für Vielfalt</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet (Equality Act 2010). Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.</p> <p>Die in dieser Stellenbeschreibung enthaltenen Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Natur und das Niveau der von den Personen in dieser Position ausgeführten Arbeiten beschreiben. Sie sind nicht als vollständige Liste aller Verantwortlichkeiten, Pflichten und Fähigkeiten gedacht, die für das Personal in dieser Position erforderlich sind.</p> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>About Charles River Associates<br><br>Charles River Associates</strong> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.<br><br><strong>Position Overview<br><br></strong>CRA’s<strong> Life Sciences</strong> Practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and digital health companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business including commercial strategy, pricing and access, innovation, organisation structure, policy analysis, medical affairs, stakeholder management, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organisations, and advocacy groups.<br><br>Our dedicated Life Sciences Practice brings clarity and solutions to complex challenges. Clients turn to us when they need to make the right decision, implement it the right way, and secure buy-in from key stakeholders. Their trust in us is rooted in our emphatic focus on clients and specifically our hands-on life sciences experience, in-depth sector knowledge, from R&D to market entry and beyond and strong academic credentials in science, economics, and business.<br><br>The CRA Life Sciences team operates from offices across the United States and Europe to provide insights on global issues and local market challenges, allowing ease of access for our clients.<br><br>Joining the Life Sciences Practice at CRA will provide you with a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge of healthcare globally. Our Internship program is meant to mirror the analyst experience to give you a greater understanding of our business and the type of work that is done at Charles River Associates.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br>Interns </strong>are curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems. Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist du die persönliche Ansprechperson für unsere Abschlussjahrgänge, von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, das Onboarding läuft über Videos und Formulare. Du kümmerst dich um das, was Automatisierung nicht kann: echte Beziehungen zu den Jahrgängen aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jedes Projekt sicher ins Ziel kommt. Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst. Aufgaben Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht. Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert. Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden. Video-Sprechstunden: Wir bauen buchbare Video-Calls auf, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Begleitung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Du gestaltest das Format mit und führst die Calls. Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten. Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen. So arbeiten wir Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird. Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen. Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich. Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt. Qualifikation Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst. Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache. Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil. Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick. Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks. Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen. Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind. Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen. Benefits Unser Angebot Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: vom Support hin zu echtem Customer Success mit Upselling und Referral Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Energy Exemplar</strong></p> <p>In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. </p> <p>Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:</p> <ul> <li><em>SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.</em></li> <li><em>Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.</em></li> <li><em>IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners</em></li> <li><em>Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category</em></li> <li><em>Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change</em></li> <li><em>Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>How We Work</strong></p> <p>Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.</p> <p>We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.</p> <p>Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. title: Senior Solutions Consultant, Presales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>We are looking for a highly experienced technical strategist and innovator who enjoys solving business problems with enterprise AI solutions. This isn't about demoing software; it's about architecting a new future for how the world's leading companies plan, decide and act. </p> <p>As a core Solution Consultant, you will join our presales team supporting some of our largest enterprise customers.  You will be responsible for all aspects of the technical sales process by working directly with customers and collaborating with sales, domain specialists, business value consultants, product managers, customer success, and partners. A strong foundational understanding of FP&A or Financial Transformation, Supply Chain domain or Workforce planning will make you stand out to the Anaplan hiring team. </p> <p><strong>Why this Role Matters</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Decision Making is moving fast in the AI era. Business leaders are no longer looking for just cost control – they need forecasting automation, cross-functional alignment, and real-time insights. You’ll help them get there. </li> <li>You’ll work with decision-makers at leading enterprise organisations, influencing outcomes that impact thousands of employees and billions in revenue.</li> <li>You’ll be working on the cutting edge of innovation to bring to life our vision of AI-driven scenario planning and analysis across a connected enterprise. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities and Impact</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Partner with account executives on technical strategy and sales process for accounts in your territory. </li> <li>Be the technical solution expert across platform capabilities, including AI, data modelling and planning applications. </li> <li>Lead discovery sessions that move beyond features and functions to uncover critical business needs. </li> <li>Design and deliver tailored, narrative-driven demos that directly address customer pain points and showcase a clear vision for their future. </li> <li>Execute proof-of-concept workshops that prove Anaplan's value in the customer’s own context. </li> <li>Serve as the voice of the customer to our product management teams, ensuring your insights from the field shape the future of the Anaplan platform. </li> <li>Coordinate and align specialist and product teams to help position multi-product solutions and mature complex opportunities to close. </li> <li>Develop a multi-year technology vision and roadmap with your customers in cooperation with the Anaplan Customer Success team. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Qualifications</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluency in German is </strong>required for this role. </li> <li>Hands-on experience with enterprise planning processes (e.g., FP&A or FCR, Supply Chain, Workforce, Sales Performance) in a presales, solution consulting, or business transformation role (SaaS/enterprise software preferred). <strong>Specific experience in FP&A</strong> is preferred. </li> <li>Experience collaborating with account executives and owning the technical sales process, including account strategy, discovery, demos, solution roadmaps and other technical validation steps. </li> <li>Strong grasp of value-based selling and storytelling, not just showing features and functions. </li> <li>Skilled in problem solving at the intersection of technology and business. </li> <li>Proven ability to make complex ideas sound simple, clear, and persuasive with experience in public speaking. </li> <li>Knowledge of enterprise AI platforms, GenAI, Agentic frameworks, machine learning, and data integration. </li> <li>Familiarity with EPM, CPM, BI, or ERP systems is a strong asset.</li> <li>Prior industry experience with aligned accounts is a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  </p> <p><strong><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW36347262 BCX0">Privacy & AI</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW36347262 BCX0"> Notice</span></strong></p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Outsourced Sales Manager: Vinted Go Acquisition
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Vinted Go grows by signing new pick-up/drop-off locations, and a large share of that growth is delivered by external sales agencies. You will own that network: the agencies running our field sales, virtual calling and digital outreach across Europe and the US.</p> <p>Today these relationships are managed in a fragmented way. Your job is to turn them into one well-governed, high-performing extension of the acquisition team, with clear targets, a consistent operating rhythm and a single point of accountability.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership role. You will act as an agency manager, performance analyst and budget owner, and above all as the guardian of the Vinted Go sales approach in every conversation an agency has on our behalf. You will build on the structure that already exists.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <p><strong>Agency & Channel Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full relationship with every outsourced sales partner across countries: onboarding, day-to-day management, escalations and offboarding</li> <li>Be the single point of accountability for agency sales results, replacing today's fragmented oversight</li> <li>Negotiate and manage contracts, SLAs and commercial terms, including pay-for-performance structures</li> <li>Evaluate, select and onboard new sales agencies as we enter new markets</li> <li>Build one operating framework (reporting cadence, WBRs, MBRs, escalation paths) that works the same way across agencies, channels and countries</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and track sales KPIs and SLAs per agency, channel and market: conversion, signed locations per rep, productivity, lead quality and adherence to the Vinted Go pitch</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into performance across the whole network</li> <li>Spot underperforming agencies or markets early and drive corrective action plans</li> <li>Translate acquisition targets set by leadership into agency-level performance expectations</li> <li>Run calibration and quality assurance (call reviews, field ride-alongs) so every agency sells consistently</li> </ul> <p><strong>Budget Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the outsourced sales budget across all agencies and countries: forecasting, spend tracking and variance reporting</li> <li>Analyze cost per outcome (CAC, cost per signed location, cost per hour) across agencies, channels and markets to drive efficiency</li> <li>Find and execute cost optimizations without compromising quality</li> <li>Report on budget and performance regularly to finance and leadership</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale & Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design the processes and governance needed to run a multi-agency, multi-country, multi-language sales network sustainably</li> <li>Build and maintain playbooks for opening new markets and onboarding new agencies</li> <li>Work with the acquisition team to align on targets, budgets and reporting standards</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Senior experience managing external sales agencies or outsourced sales teams (field sales, telesales, digital lead generation), ideally across several countries and vendors at once</li> <li>A background in sales, acquisition or growth in a high-velocity environment, so you know what good looks like on the ground</li> <li>A strong record of agency performance management: setting KPIs and SLAs, running WBRs and MBRs, and driving accountability</li> <li>Budget ownership: forecasting, tracking and optimizing spend across multiple vendors or cost centers</li> <li>Comfort building structure and process from a relatively unstructured starting point</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, working easily in dashboards, reporting tools and a CRM to track performance and cost</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills: you hold agencies accountable while keeping the partnership productive</li> <li>Comfort working across time zones and cultures</li> <li>Fluent English; French and/or Spanish is an advantage</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Matters</h2> <p>Outsourced sales is one of the main ways Vinted Go signs new locations at scale, and it is growing in every market we enter. This role brings order, accountability and cost discipline to that network, and lays the foundation for further international and product growth.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy </strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Finance Officer
company: OLR Holdings Ltd trading as DFYNE
description: Role: Senior Finance Officer Location: DFYNE HQ, 1 Forrest Gate, Uddingston, G71 5PG Work Location: Onsite About You: Are you someone who loves getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger financial picture? Do you enjoy turning numbers into meaningful insight, spotting trends, strengthening controls, and ensuring everything balances exactly as it should? Are you equally comfortable preparing management accounts, analysing variances, managing fixed assets, and rolling up your sleeves to process invoices and reconcile supplier accounts? If you're highly organised, commercially aware, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, DFYNE may be the place for you. About DFYNE: A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to be sat here reading an essay of corporate “about us” spiel…. Seriously, how’re you able to really get under the skin of what we’re about from a few words on a screen. So why don’t you have a look and see what we’re all about for yourself - www.dfyne.com. About the role - DFYNE Your Career: First off, it's best I introduce myself (person behind the keyboard here). It’s not the norm on a job advert, but I think it’s important you get introduced to who you might be working with for a long time early on. I'm Luca, Chief Financial Officer at DFYNE, and I'm looking for someone who can help us continue building a world-class finance function as we scale globally. This isn't a traditional management accountant role where you'll only focus on month-end reporting from a distance. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of accurate and timely management accounts while remaining hands-on across accounts payable, fixed asset management, lease accounting, financial controls, and commercial analysis. You'll be responsible for ensuring financial information is reliable, insightful, and delivered on time, whilst maintaining strong processes that keep the day-to-day finance operation running smoothly. You'll partner with teams across the business, challenge costs where appropriate, identify risks and opportunities, and support the continued growth of DFYNE through sound financial management. Attitude: Ownership mentality Detail obsessed Commercially curious Problem solver Calm under pressure Continuous improvement mindset Key Responsibilities 1. Management Accounts & Month-End Reporting: Prepare monthly management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet, and supporting schedules, to agreed deadlines. Post and review accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortisation, and other month-end journals; maintain clear supporting working papers. Complete and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigate differences, and resolve outstanding items. Analyse actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods, explaining material variances and cost trends to management. Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, and improvements to management reporting. Ensure accurate cut-off, allocation of costs to departments and cost centres, and completeness of month-end liabilities. Work with the Finance Team Lead on audit preparation, financial controls, and process improvements. 2. Fixed Assets & Right-of-Use (ROU) Asset Accounting: Maintain and reconcile the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), ensuring accurate accounting for capital expenditure (CapEx), additions, disposals, and depreciation calculations. Manage Right-of-Use (ROU) asset schedules and lease liabilities in accordance with relevant accounting standards (IFRS 16 / FRS 102), ensuring monthly lease interest and depreciation journals are accurately posted. Review purchase invoices and CapEx requests to ensure correct capitalisation treatment versus operational expense (OpEx). Perform periodic physical asset verifications/audits and reconcile asset register balances to general ledger control accounts. Prepare lease schedules, impairment reviews, and disclosures for month-end and year-end statutory audit reporting. 3. Daily Finance Inbox & Invoice Control: Manage and clear the finance inbox daily, with visible Processed/Actioned and pending categories to support seamless handovers. Register 100% of incoming invoices in NetSuite within two working days and maintain visibility of future payment liabilities. Verify supplier invoice details, dates, values, and UK VAT treatment; accurately code invoices to general ledger accounts and cost centres. Assess expenditure for value for money; query unexpected charges with department heads and place unresolved invoices on hold. 4. Reconciliations & Financial Control: Regularly review and cleanse the accounts payable ledger, resolving aged balances, unapplied payments, and debit notes. Reconcile supplier statements, the AP sub-ledger, fixed asset registers, lease schedules, and the general ledger before month-end close. Keep AP postings aligned with bank payment schedules and investigate discrepancies promptly. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records and comply with applicable HMRC VAT and record-keeping requirements. 5. Specialist Logistics Accounting: Process outbound shipping invoices weekly, clearing relevant inbox items before posting; post matching journals on the same day for accurate cost-centre reporting. Register returns logistics invoices on receipt, complete checks using the available checker, and post required journals. Experience Needed: AAT-qualified, part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or qualified by experience with substantial relevant responsibility. Demonstrable hands-on experience preparing monthly management accounts and completing month-end close. Practical experience in maintaining fixed asset registers, calculating depreciation, and managing capital expenditure accounting. Strong practical accounts payable experience, including high-volume invoices, supplier reconciliations, and payment runs. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable cloud ERP; sound Excel skills for reconciliations and reporting. Skills: Understanding of lease accounting principles and Right-of-Use (ROU) asset management under IFRS 16 or FRS 102. Confident with journals, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis. Good understanding of UK VAT, HMRC documentation requirements, general ledger coding, and financial controls. Organised, accurate, and commercially aware; comfortable challenging costs and working independently to deadlines. Able to communicate effectively with department heads, suppliers, and senior finance colleagues. So, what’s in it for you?: If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant, I’d love to hear from you. Besides a work family and a great place to work, you’ll have an opportunity to grow with the company, be a part of the journey, and have a vital input into helping continue the crazy growth we’ve already seen. You’ll be part of a high challenge, high reward culture. Salary: Starting from £52,430 annually. Completing this form is voluntary and the information provided will be kept confidential. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation. title: Flight Data Monitoring Manager
description: Model: Onsite Scope: Full Time Location: Stans, Switzerland Description: As the Flight Data Monitoring (FDM/FOQA) Manager, you will be responsible for the oversight, development, and continuous improvement of the organization's Flight Data Monitoring program. Configure and maintain FDM/FOQA software platforms, including event definitions, detection logic, and reporting frameworks. Develop meaningful safety reports, dashboards, and recommendations for senior management and operational teams. Ensure data quality, integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable regulations and company policies. Collaborate with Flight Operations, Safety Management System (SMS) teams, and other stakeholders to investigate and mitigate safety concerns. Monitor industry best practices and emerging technologies within flight data analysis and aviation safety. Support audits, regulatory inspections, and safety reviews. Requirements Proven experience managing a Flight Data Monitoring (FDM/FOQA) Program or performing advanced flight data analysis within an airline, aviation operator, or aviation consultancy. Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Engineering, Data Analytics, Aeronautics, or a related field. Advanced proficiency with FDM/FOQA software platforms and flight data analysis tools. Strong knowledge of: Event configuration and definition Flight data interpretation and trend analysis Safety reporting and risk assessment Data analytics and performance monitoring In-depth understanding of aviation regulations and standards, including: EASA FAA ICAO Safety Management System (SMS) requirements Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. title: Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications (m/w/d) 80-100%
description: About Traila At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable. Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments. What you will do - Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies. - Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems. - Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices. - Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols. - Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application. - Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required. - Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently. - Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant. - Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases. - Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences. - Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team. - Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities. - Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems. What you bring - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. - Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment. - Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service. - Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed. - Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems. - Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use. - Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable. - Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products. - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces. - Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows. - A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution. - Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly. - Fluent English; German is a strong advantage. Nice to have - Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems. - MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience. - Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable. - Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS. - Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment. Benefits 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas. Flexible working hours and home office options. Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences. Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage. A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. If you want your software engineering to have real-world impact in rail, we’d like to hear from you. Contact Yasi Samari, HR Responsible, by applying directly here. title: Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
description: Über die Bovensiepen Group Was 1965 in Kaufbeuren als Vision von Burkard Bovensiepen begann, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit unverwechselbarer DNA. Seit Jahren wird das Familienunternehmen von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian geführt und steht für automobile Meisterwerke, handwerkliche Exzellenz und Perfektion in jedem Detail. Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht. Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit. Ihre Rolle – Kundenerlebnis, Auftrag und Weiterentwicklung in einer Hand Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge. Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht. Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? Wann ist der richtige Zeitpunkt für die passende Sonderausstattung? Ihre Antworten setzen Sie selbst um. 50 Meter neben Ihrem Schreibtisch entstehen die Fahrzeuge, die Sie betreuen. Unsere Arbeitszeit: 40 Wochenstunden in Vollzeit, verteilt auf Montag bis Donnerstag und Freitag bis mittags. Teilzeit ist ab 30 Stunden möglich, die Verteilung besprechen wir gemeinsam. Aufgaben Konfiguration und Individualisierung: Sie beraten Kunden gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu Ausstattung, Materialien, Lackfarben und Interieur und übersetzen ihre Wünsche in verbindliche Fertigungs- und Aufbereitungsaufträge. Zusatzgeschäft mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Sie bieten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Sonderausstattung und Zusatzleistungen rund um Pflege und Service an, stets beratend, niemals drängend. Auftragssteuerung: Sie verfolgen Termine, klären Detailfragen direkt mit Manufaktur, Werkstatt, Einkauf und Logistik und informieren den Kunden proaktiv über jeden Meilenstein. Damit sind Sie die zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kunden. Übergabe als Höhepunkt: Sie planen und gestalten die Fahrzeugübergabe in Buchloe, beim Handelspartner oder beim Kunden, nicht als Ende des Prozesses, sondern als den ersten Höhepunkt einer langfristigen Kundenbeziehung. Nachbetreuung: Sie orchestrieren nach der Übergabe in Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und Handelspartnern den laufenden Kontakt, holen Feedback ein, lösen Anliegen schnell und erkennen Anlässe für Zubehör, Service oder das nächste Fahrzeug. Customer Journey weiterentwickeln: Sie werten Kundenfeedback und Zufriedenheitswerte aus, verbessern die Kontaktpunkte laufend und bringen Ideen für Kundenevents, Manufakturbesuche und Übergabeformate ein. Daten, die tragen: Sie pflegen Kunden- und Auftragsdaten in CRM und ERP so, dass Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung darauf Entscheidungen bauen. Diese Rolle ist nicht die Sachbearbeitung hinter dem Vertrieb. Sie ist das Gesicht von Bovensiepen zwischen erster Anfrage und Schlüsselübergabe, und auch weit darüber hinaus. Was Sie in den ersten zwölf Monaten bewegen Sie lernen Kunden, Handelspartner, Manufaktur und Fahrzeuge kennen und führen die ersten Aufträge eigenverantwortlich zur Übergabe. Sie zeichnen die heutige Customer Journey auf und benennen die Momente, die begeistern – und die, die wir verbessern. Sie entwickeln ein Übergabe- und Nachbetreuungskonzept, das unsere Kunden so noch nicht erlebt haben und das nachhaltig in Erinnerung bleibt. Sie bauen ein Angebot aus Sonderausstattung, Zusatzleistungen und Erlebnis auf, das zum Kunden passt und machen seinen Erfolg messbar. Qualifikation Ihr Profil – Gastfreundschaft und Kaufmannsverstand Sie haben ein echtes Gespür für Menschen und Freude daran, sie zu begeistern. Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. Sie verkaufen gern, weil Sie wissen, dass das richtige Angebot zur richtigen Zeit für den Kunden ein Gewinn ist. Was Sie mitbringen Kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Automobilkaufleute) oder Studium Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Order Management oder Vertrieb – im Premium-Automobilumfeld oder mit ähnlich anspruchsvoller Klientel, etwa bei Luxusmarken, in der Premium-Hotellerie oder im Private Banking Freude am Verkaufen und nachweisbare Erfolge im Zusatz- oder Folgegeschäft Begeisterung für hochwertige Fahrzeuge und den Willen, sich tief in deren Ausstattungswelt einzuarbeiten Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- (Creatio) und ERP-Systemen (z. B. Microsoft Business Central) und MS Office Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch, Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Übergaben Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt Erfahrung mit BMW oder anderen Premium-Marken Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. B. NPS) Weitere Fremdsprache (Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch) für die Betreuung internationaler Kunden Was uns wichtiger ist als jedes Zertifikat: der Instinkt für Menschen, der Wille, jeden Auftrag zu Ende zu denken, und die Freude daran, für einen Kunden mehr möglich zu machen, als er erwartet hat. Benefits Was wir bieten Familienunternehmen seit mehr als 60 Jahren: Kurze Wege zwischen Kunde, Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung. Ihre Ideen landen nicht in einer Abstimmungsschleife, sondern bei den Menschen, die entscheiden. Gestaltungsspielraum: Eine neue Rolle, die Sie von Beginn an prägen, mit klarer Verantwortung für das Kundenerlebnis Erfolgsbeteiligung: Fixgehalt zwischen 52.000 und 60.000 € brutto im Jahr (in Teilzeit anteilig) je nach Erfahrung plus Bonus, gekoppelt an die Zusatzverkäufe und die Zufriedenheit Ihrer Kunden, damit Ihr Beitrag direkt sichtbar wird Direkte Berichtslinie an die Vertriebsleitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung Produktnähe: Fahrzeuge, die in Buchloe von Hand entstehen und leidenschaftliche Käufer, die Sie persönlich kennen und stets im Fokus halten Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Manufaktur und bei unseren Handelspartnern Standort Buchloe im Allgäu: Hohe Lebensqualität, direkte Anbindung Richtung München, Memmingen und Augsburg Bereit? Wenn Sie beim Lesen schon an die erste Übergabe denken, die Sie gestalten: Bewerben Sie sich über den Button auf dieser Seite. Ein Lebenslauf genügt. Ein Anschreiben ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. title: Senior Customer Trust Analyst, EMEA
description: <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Abnormal AI is looking for a Senior Customer Trust Analyst to build and lead our customer-trust program across EMEA. As the first Customer Trust hire in the region, this person will partner closely with our EMEA-based Engineering and Sales teams to foster a culture of trust between Abnormal and our customers. This role sits within the Customer Trust team, which acts as the translation layer between customers and Abnormal: translating customer security requirements into internal controls, evidence, and product or operational requirements, then translating those controls back into clear assurances customers can trust and act on.</p> <p>This role will be responsible for presenting Abnormal's control environment directly to senior buyers, designing response strategy for the highest-stakes security reviews rather than reacting question by question, and driving toward clarity when customer expectations conflict with reality. This includes advising Sales leadership on how to position the control environment to prospects and defining how the trust response process scales as deal volume grows. As the first person in this function regionally, this individual will serve as the primary point of contact for Abnormal's EMEA customer-trust program and will be accountable for outcomes that unblock revenue at scale, not just individual deals.</p> <p>The ideal candidate thrives in high-pressure customer conversations, translates security and privacy concepts for a business audience with precision, stays composed when a discussion turns contentious, and brings the business judgment to tie trust program depth to revenue outcomes. Familiarity with the EU AI Act and GDPR as they apply to a leading cybersecurity SaaS provider's customers is also expected.</p> <h2>Who you are</h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience navigating customer-facing security conversations at the highest stakes level</li> <li>Analytical thinker who connects trust program depth to revenue outcomes</li> <li>Proficient in designing a response strategy collaborative work style</li> <li>Self-motivated and able to operate with minimal oversight, owning outcomes end to end</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate as a self-starter and de facto leader, building a customer-trust function from the ground up as the first hire in a region, and comfortable navigating cross-functionally to manage customer requests without an established local team or playbook to lean on</li> </ul> <h2>What you will do </h2> <ul> <li>Own and build the customer-trust program for EMEA as the first Customer Trust hire in the region, including how conversations are prioritized, escalated, and resolved</li> <li>Contribute to defining how the trust response process scales as deal volume grows, without diluting response quality or turnaround time</li> <li>Translate customer security requirements into internal controls, evidence, and product or operational requirements that internal teams can act on</li> <li>Track and drive resolution of gaps between customer expectations and Abnormal's actual control environment, ensuring resolution is documented and communicated back to the customer</li> <li>Partner with EMEA-based Engineering and Sales teams, as well as Security and Legal, to foster a culture of trust between Abnormal and its customers across the region</li> <li>Monitor changes in customer expectations and the regulatory landscape, including the EU AI Act and GDPR, and adjust how Abnormal's control environment is presented as needed</li> <li>Maintain up-to-date content in Responsive and accurate documentation in Safebase Trust Center for EMEA</li> <li>Support the tooling that underpins the trust response process, including Responsive and Safebase Trust Center</li> <li>Engage in ad-hoc projects as required</li> <li>Maintain regular, clear communication with internal stakeholders and Sales leadership regarding conversation status, deal risk, and progress on unresolved issues</li> <li>Communicate program status, health, and key risks to senior management and Sales leadership, connecting trust program performance to revenue outcomes</li> </ul> <h2>Must Haves </h2> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in customer-facing security, trust, or compliance roles</li> <li>Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, RFPs, and security questionnaires</li> <li>Experience translating customer security requirements into internal controls, evidence, and product or operational requirements</li> <li>Strong project management skills with the ability to drive resolution across internal teams when customer expectations conflict with reality</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security and privacy concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Experience helping customers build trust with products in scope for the EU AI Act and GDPR</li> <li>Experience engaging with German works councils</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to
