title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
description: <h2><strong>About Alma</strong></h2> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Strategic Finance is part of Alma's Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma's economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.</p> <p>We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma's P&L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.</p> <h2><strong>About the job</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own your piece of the P&L.</strong> Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.</li> <li><strong>Run the key finance processes of your scope.</strong> Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.</li> <li><strong>Be a real partner to the business.</strong> Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.</li> <li><strong>Rebuild how finance works with AI.</strong> Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team's time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on <em>how</em> we work matters as much as <em>what</em> we deliver.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will work with</strong></h2> <p>Google Sheets · Excel · SQL (largely AI-assisted) · Notion · Slack · AI assistants and LLMs</p> <h2><strong> About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 6 to 7 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, transaction services, consulting or a similar analytical role, ideally including time in a fast-growing company.</li> <li>Model with ease and think in unit economics: you can build a business plan from raw data and spot when a number doesn't make sense. Querying is largely AI-assisted at Alma, so data judgement matters more than deep SQL.</li> <li>Have a strong appetite for AI and learn fast. Ideally, you have already built AI-assisted workflows and made them stick.</li> <li>Take ownership and bring business sense: you make a scope your own, you know when to step back, and you can influence people who don't report to you. You work comfortably in English and have enough French for day-to-day exchanges with colleagues (native French is not required).</li> </ul> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.</li> <li>Have exposure to fintech, payments or BNPL.</li> <li>Speak a third language beyond French and English, a real plus given our European footprint.</li> </ul> <p><em>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</em></p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership and visibility.</strong> A piece of Alma's P&L that is truly yours, with direct exposure.</li> <li><strong>AI at the core of the job.</strong> The chance to redesign how a finance team works, building the workflows rather than just using them.</li> <li><strong>A team in the making.</strong> Strategic Finance is being restructured now: you will help shape how it works, in a Next40 scale-up growing across Europe, with room to take on broader responsibilities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation & Benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li>Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li>Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li>Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li>Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li>Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li>Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li>Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our Learning & Development Platform</li> <li>2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview Process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.</li> <li>Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.</li> <li>Case study presentation with 2 - 3 team members (ideally in house) to assess your practical knowledge.</li> <li>1 or 2 additional interviews customized to the role's level to further assess your skills and team fit.</li> </ul> <h2><strong> Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h2> <p><em>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</em></p> <p></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Director of MSSP Sales, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.</p> <p>Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. </p></div><p>The Director, MSSP Sales, EMEA will architect, build, and scale ExtraHop’s dedicated MSSP and MDR business across EMEA. As ExtraHop continues to dominate the Network Detection and Response (NDR) space, this leader will transform how managed service providers leverage the Reveal(x) platform to deliver high-fidelity threat detection and response to their end customers. You will own the entire lifecycle of the MSSP relationship: from strategic partner acquisition and commercial modeling to technical enablement and co-selling execution</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br><strong>Strategy & Commercial Modeling:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Define the Go-To-Market (GTM): </strong>Design and execute a comprehensive EMEA strategy specifically targeting top-tier MSSPs and MDR providers.</li> <li><strong>Structure MSSP Frameworks: </strong>Collaborate with Finance, Product, and Operations to design scalable, competitive commercial models (e.g., consumption-based pricing, multi-tenant licensing, pay-as-you-grow, and subscription models).</li> <li><strong>Value Proposition: </strong>Refine ExtraHop's messaging to clearly articulate how our platform reduces MSSP analyst burnout, lowers mean time to resolution (MTTR), and increases partner margins.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Acquisition & Revenue Generation: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Pipeline Ownership: </strong>Directly hunt and secure predictable, recurring revenue streams by embedding ExtraHop Reveal(x) into the core tech stacks of major MSSPs</li> <li><strong>Co-Sell & Sell-Through: </strong>Drive both "sell-to" (the MSSP's own infrastructure) and "sell-through/with" (leveraging the MSSP's sales force to pull ExtraHop into enterprise accounts) revenue streams.</li> <li><strong>Executive Relationships: </strong>Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-level executives (CEOs, CISOs, CTOs) within the target MSSP ecosystem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership & Enablement: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Team Building: </strong>Act as a player-coach initially, with the mandate to recruit, hire, and lead a high-performing team of MSSP Account Managers and Channel Solutions Architects as the business scales.</li> <li><strong>Enablement Ecosystem: </strong>Partner with ExtraHop Technical Marketing and Sales Enablement to build specialized onboarding, technical training, and co-marketing (MDF) programs tailored for MSSPs.</li> <li><strong>Product Feedback Loop: </strong>Act as the voice of the MSSP partner internally, providing feedback to Product Management regarding multi-tenancy, API integrations, and reporting capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong><br>●      10+ Years in Cybersecurity Sales: A proven track record of selling enterprise-grade security software (preferably NDR, EDR, SIEM, or XDR).<br>●      5+ Years of Dedicated MSSP/MDR Leadership: Direct experience owning, scaling, and structuring deals with major MSSPs (e.g., Optiv, Secureworks, Verizon, Deloitte, Expel).<br>●      Proven "Zero-to-One" Success: Experience building a new route-to-market, division, or partner program from scratch within an established tech company.<br>●      Complex Commercial Structuring: Deep familiarity with usage-based, multi-tenant, and utility pricing models.</p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong><br>●      High Technical Acumen: Ability to speak authoritatively with MSSP SOC Directors and CTOs about architecture, APIs, and integration ecosystems.<br>●      Strong Operational Discipline: Ability to accurately forecast revenue based on a partner led managed service sales motion rather than direct to customer sales motion.<br>●      Gravitas & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate complex, multi-party enterprise deal cycles.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ABOUT EXTRAHOP</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.</p> <p>This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.</p> <p><strong>OUR VALUES</strong></p> <p>Our culture is rooted in our five <strong>Values</strong>. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. </p> <p><strong>Lead with Purpose:</strong> We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.</p> <p><strong>Act with Integrity:</strong> We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. </p> <p><strong>Find a Way:</strong> We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.</p> <p><strong>Innovate: </strong>We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.</p> <p><strong>Share Success:</strong> We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. </p> <p><strong>BENEFITS</strong></p> <p><strong>Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team.</strong> Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits</li> <li>Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time</li> <li>Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan</li> <li>FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable</li> <li>Educational Reimbursement</li> <li>401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable</li> <li>Pet Insurance (US Only)</li> <li>Parental Leave (US Only)</li> <li>Hybrid and Remote Work Model</li> </ul> <p>Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!  </p> <p><strong>To learn more, visit </strong><a href="https://www.extrahop.com/"><strong>our website</strong></a><strong> or follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/extrahop-networks/"><strong>LinkedIn</strong></a><strong>. </strong></p> <p><strong>Create a Job Alert</strong></p> <p>Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.</p> <p>You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack.</p> <p>You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.</p> <p>This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.</p> <p>You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.</p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.</li> <li>Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.</li> <li>The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A self-directed approach to solving complex problems, identifying gaps and driving improvements.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h2>Sponsorship</h2> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to shape how Graphcore tests its ML software stack? Apply now to join our ML QA team.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive (German Speaking)
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically Switzerland/Zurich/Geneva. Regional Expectations Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus. German Language Expectations Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations. Opportunity Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights! What You'll Do Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing You’ll Love This Role If You Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech It’s Important to Us That You Have Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences Strong written and verbal communication skills Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success. It Would Be Great If You Had Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies. Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. title: Junior Business Data Analyst

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description: „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Deine Mission Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr: Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen. Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt. Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung. Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst. Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark. Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach. Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich. Was du mitbringst Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden. Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen. Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen. Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht. Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl. Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast. Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt. Was wir dir geben Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent. Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen. Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir. Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten. Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt. Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag. Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken. Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe. Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
description: <p>Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. </p> <p>JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.</li> <li>Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.</li> <li>Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.</li> <li>Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.</li> <li>Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.</li> <li>Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.</li> <li>Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.</li> <li>Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.</li> <li>A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.</li> <li>Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.</li> <li>Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.</li> <li>Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.</li> <li>Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.</li> <li>A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.</li> <li>An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.</li> <li>The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.</li> <li>Fluency in English, both written and spoken.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:</p> <ul> <li>Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).</li> <li>Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.</li> <li>Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.</li> <li>Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.</li> <li>Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join JetBrains?</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.</li> <li>Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.</li> <li>Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.</li> <li>Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.</li> </ul> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p>If this sounds like a challenge you'd enjoy, send us your resume and a short note on why you're interested in Air.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KL1 </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. title: Director of Product Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p> </p> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.</p> <p>A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build.</p> <p>You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll build</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.</li> <li>Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products.</li> <li>Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics.</li> <li>A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers.</li> <li>Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.</li> <li>An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></h2> <p>The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.</p> <p>Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.</p> <h2><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.</li> <li>You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch.</li> <li>You understand modern technical acquisition. You're credible directing AEO, SEO, paid programs and developer-focused content, and can connect channel-level metrics to funnel economics and qualified pipeline.</li> <li>You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools.</li> <li>You write exceptionally well, have strong instincts for enterprise sales, and know how to turn a complex product advantage into a clear reason to buy.</li> <li>You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.</li> </ul> <p>Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.</p> <h2><strong>Why Telnyx</strong></h2> <p>This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.</p> <h4><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></h4> <p>Telnyx is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on the skills and experience relevant to the role.</p> <h3><span style="font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px;">#LI-RH1</span></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Network Customer Support Engineer
description: Location: Zurich, Paris or Munich Language: Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. About Us Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact. Role Outcome The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network. This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale. Success in this role means: Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers. When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis. The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction. A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow. Immediate Areas of Focus Own the customer experience of our Network Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues. Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions. Deliver High-Quality Technical Support Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer. Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases. Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers. Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents. Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team. Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale. Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact. Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as: Network uptime and availability Incident response and resolution times Support response and resolution times Alert quality and monitoring coverage Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency. Surface Operational and Customer Insights Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data. Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering. Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized. Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction. Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact. Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise. Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team. Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication. Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness. Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows. Qualifications Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English. Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems. Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies). Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems. Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes. Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers. Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis. Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering. Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment. Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Our Cultural Foundation At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position. This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact . It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them. That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today , not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows. We think about our culture in two dimensions: How We Show Up Every Day These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate: Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting. High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us. Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles. No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together. Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust. Operating Principles These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level: Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning. No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy. Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most. If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam. What you'll do in this role Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability. Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly. Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer. Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns. Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance. Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack. Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices. What you bring to the table 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering. Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML. Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail. Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply. Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries. Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level. Experience with containerised workflows using Docker. Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively. Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow. Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features. What success in the first 6 months looks like You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts. You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer. You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue. You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks. You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant. You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you. Current tech stack We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach. Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns. What we offer: Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company. Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. Hybrid working model. Policies to support working parents. Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office. Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Sr Talent & People Partner
description: Über Rivia Rivia ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das eine Datenplattform entwickelt, die die Zukunft der klinischen Studienanalyse prägt. Rivia wurde aus der Überzeugung heraus gegründet, dass sich neue Medikamente mit einem Bruchteil des heutigen Kapitals erfolgreicher auf den Markt bringen lassen. Biotech-Unternehmen sind die wichtigste Quelle therapeutischer Innovationen. Ihre klinische Entwicklung wird jedoch immer wieder durch fragmentierte Daten und veraltete Werkzeuge ausgebremst. Rivia führt klinische Studiendaten in großem Maßstab zusammen. Das Herzstück ist eine wiederverwendbare intelligente Datenplattform mit Hunderten von Konfigurationen und studienspezifischen Logiken, die unabhängig von der Struktur der Quelldaten funktioniert. Diese vertikal integrierte Kombination aus Datenplattform, Workflows und KI-Agenten schafft einen entscheidenden Vorteil bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien. In den vergangenen zwei Jahren haben Biotech-Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA, die mit Rivia weltweit klinische Studien durchführen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielt: von einem früheren Verständnis des therapeutischen Potenzials bis hin zu deutlich effizienteren Studienabläufen. Im März 2026 nahm Rivia in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 15 Millionen US-Dollar auf, angeführt von Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia will zur Standardinfrastruktur für die moderne Arzneimittelentwicklung werden und die Durchführung klinischer Studien von Anfang bis Ende grundlegend verändern. Die Rolle Als Senior Talent & People Partner bist du die erste Verstärkung im People-Team von Rivia. Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs baust du die Funktion von Grund auf auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess und wächst zugleich in weitere People-Themen hinein: Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklung, Performance, Unternehmenskultur, Organisationsgestaltung und Personalprozesse. Die Position bietet erfahrenen Recruiter:innen die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Schritt in eine umfassendere People-Rolle zu machen. Ein fertiges HR-Handbuch, das du einfach übernimmst, gibt es nicht. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Prozesse, lösen neue Herausforderungen, probieren Ideen aus und schaffen die Grundlagen für das Wachstum von Rivia. Durch praktische Verantwortung, enge Zusammenarbeit und Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungen wie auch operative Herausforderungen lernst du direkt von der Leitung des People-Bereichs. Du bist die enge Sparringspartner:in der Leitung des People-Bereichs: Du denkst selbstständig, arbeitest vertrauensvoll zusammen und packst mit an. Du bringst Ideen ein, hinterfragst Annahmen, handelst schnell und setzt Vorhaben konsequent um. Gesucht ist jemand, der versteht, wie People-Arbeit zum Geschäftserfolg beiträgt, und Führungskräfte wirklich beraten möchte – statt lediglich Prozesse abzuarbeiten. Was dich begeistert Du liebst Recruiting, möchtest dich aber über Talent Acquisition hinaus weiterentwickeln und das gesamte People-Spektrum kennenlernen. Die erste Person im People-Team zu sein und alles von Grund auf mit aufzubauen, reizt dich mehr, als ein bestehendes Handbuch zu pflegen. Du arbeitest eng mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs zusammen, hinterfragst Ideen und lernst durch echte Verantwortung. Du findest außergewöhnliche Talente und baust vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften mit den einstellenden Führungskräften auf. Du löst komplexe Geschäfts- und People-Fragen schnell, neugierig und pragmatisch. Du möchtest die Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Zusammenarbeit verbessern. Du ergreifst die Initiative, behältst verschiedene Prioritäten im Blick und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Deine Aufgaben Talent Acquisition Du verantwortest den gesamten Einstellungsprozess über alle Teams hinweg – von der Definition der Rolle über Talent Mapping, Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Betreuung der Kandidat:innen bis hin zu Angeboten und Vertragsabschlüssen. Du berätst einstellende Führungskräfte fundiert zu Recruiting-Strategie, Marktbedingungen, Qualität der Kandidat:innen und möglichen Kompromissen. Du baust proaktiv Talent-Pipelines auf und sorgst für eine wertschätzende, verlässliche Candidate Experience. Du verbesserst Recruiting-Prozesse, ATS-Workflows, Reporting und Recruiting-Analysen. Mitarbeitererfahrung und Entwicklung Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs entwickelst du Onboarding, Mitarbeitererfahrung, Engagement, Unternehmenskultur und Entwicklungsinitiativen weiter. Du unterstützt die Einführung von Performance Reviews, Feedback-Praktiken, Karriereentwicklung und Angeboten für Führungskräfte. Du hörst den Anliegen von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften zu, erkennst Reibungspunkte und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. People Operations und Business-Partnerschaft Du hilfst dabei, skalierbare People-Prozesse, Richtlinien, Systeme und Abläufe entlang des gesamten Beschäftigungsverhältnisses von Grund auf aufzubauen. Du unterstützt Führungskräfte mit pragmatischer, geschäftsorientierter Beratung und durchdachten Personalentscheidungen. Mit wachsendem Verantwortungsbereich arbeitest du an Projekten zu Organisationsgestaltung, Vergütung, HR Operations und People Analytics mit. Du erkennst Probleme früh, schlägst Lösungen vor und kümmerst dich um deren Umsetzung, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten. Was du mitbringst Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Umfassende Erfahrung im Recruiting über den gesamten Einstellungsprozess hinweg sowie nachweisbare Erfolge bei der eigenständigen Besetzung anspruchsvoller Positionen. Den Wunsch, dich in eine umfassendere People-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln; Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in ist nicht erforderlich. Du baust gern Neues auf, löst Probleme, handelst schnell, denkst kritisch und übernimmst Verantwortung bis zur Umsetzung. Geschäftssinn und die Sicherheit, einstellende Führungskräfte und andere Verantwortliche zu hinterfragen, zu überzeugen und zu beraten. Du fühlst dich wohl mit offenen Fragestellungen, hohen Erwartungen, mehreren parallelen Prioritäten und praktischer Arbeit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, gutes Urteilsvermögen, Organisationstalent und Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management. Neugier, Bescheidenheit und die Bereitschaft, neue People-Fachgebiete zu erschließen. Von Vorteil Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts. Einblicke in Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Performance Management oder Mitarbeiterengagement. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up sowie Vertrautheit mit ATS-, HRIS- oder People-Analytics-Systemen. Bewerbungsprozess Unser Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwei bis vier Wochen und umfasst vier Schritte: Kennenlernen: 30-minütiges erstes Gespräch mit dem People-Team. Vertiefendes Gespräch: Austausch mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs über Recruiting, Business-Partnerschaft und deine Entwicklungsziele. Praxisaufgabe: Gemeinsame Bearbeitung einer realistischen Recruiting- und People-Herausforderung. Kennenlernen des Teams: Gespräche vor Ort in Zürich, um herauszufinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen. Unsere Werte Bei Rivia setzen wir auf Spitzenleistung, kontinuierliches Lernen und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen und unseres Teams. Mit vollem Einsatz gewinnen: Herausforderungen mit Entschlossenheit, Ausdauer und Tatkraft angehen. Veränderung annehmen: Wandel als Chance zur Verbesserung sehen. Warum eigentlich nicht?: Annahmen hinterfragen und neugierig bleiben. Lücken erkennen: Probleme frühzeitig identifizieren und lösen. Gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen: Zusammen für Ergebnisse einstehen und einander unterstützen. Lösungen mit Mehrwert schaffen: Sinnvolle Ergebnisse erzielen, die wirklich etwas bewirken. title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations. What you’ll do Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability. Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up. Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations. What you'll bring Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC). NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Nice to have: Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite). Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP). Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope. Integration Engineer Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces. Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team. Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions. Senior Integration Engineer Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments. Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow. Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe. If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich. Employment: full-time, permanent. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . title: Marketing Events Planner

Event strategy and playbooks : Support the creation of event strategies, playbooks, budgets, and staffing requirements. Ensure every event aligns with company goals and delivers a seamless experience. title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future. Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise. We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology. This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas. Tasks Implement real-time control, analysis, data acquisition systems in the kHz to MHz range, as individual contributor and in a team. Integrate solutions across a variety of company products and services as well as on our in-house test beds. Provide technical leadership within a growing real-time control and software engineering team that you will help to build. Translate customer needs into requirements and specifications. Requirements Experience taking hard-real-time acquisition and control loops from incomplete requirements through to commissioning on hardware, in domains such as automotive, robotics, embedded, electrical and/or scientific instrumentation. ‘Full stack’: familiarity with all aspects of real-time technologies, from physical/DAQ, real-time software frameworks and middleware, real-time OS and integration. Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability. Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage. Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage. Benefits The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up. The opportunity to build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts. Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life. Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance. If you are excited about joining our team, send your CV including information about a real-time system you have taken into operation. We're looking forward to hearing from you. title: Campaign & Account Manager DACH – Mandarin (all genders)

Dazu gehören Launch-Kampagnen, langfristige Creator-Partnerschaften und Aktivierungen auf Messen wie der IFA in Berlin und der gamescom in Köln.
