Wir wollen das ändern, mit Dir als direktem Draht zwischen den chinesischen HQs und unseren Kampagnen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Start: ab Februar 2027. Deine Rolle Als Campaign & Account Manager DACH mit Mandarin-Kenntnissen und Affinität zu Tech & Consumer Electronics bist Du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren chinesisch-sprachigen Kunden und unserem operativen Team in Deutschland. Deine Aufgaben 1. Influencer Campaign Management Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst Influencer- und KOL-Kampagnen für den DACH-Markt – von der Konzeption bis zur Auswertung. Du recherchierst geeignete Creator und bewertest deren Zielgruppen, Content, Reichweite und Markenfit. Du entwickelst Kampagnenbriefings und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Creators und internen Teams. Du behältst Timings, Budgets, Content-Freigaben und Qualitätsstandards im Blick. Du verfolgst Entwicklungen, Trends und Plattformen im Influencer Marketing und bringst relevante Erkenntnisse in unsere Arbeit ein. 2. Account Management & Kundenberatung Du bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Du verstehst die Ziele und Anforderungen unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in passende Influencer-Marketing-Strategien Du präsentierst Kampagnenkonzepte, Ergebnisse und Handlungsempfehlungen. Du sorgst für transparente Kommunikation und eine professionelle Betreuung über den gesamten Kampagnenverlauf hinweg. 3. Business Development & Marktentwicklung Du unterstützt den Ausbau unserer Geschäftsbeziehungen zu chinesischen Marken, die den deutschen und europäischen Markt erschließen möchten. Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und unterstützt bei Pitches und Präsentationen. Du bringst Dein Verständnis des chinesischen Marktes und der dortigen Geschäftskultur ein. Du unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Positionierung und unser Leistungsangebot für chinesische Kunden weiterzuentwickeln. Betreuung unserer Kunden auf internationalen Branchenmessen wie der IFA Berlin und der gamescom Köln. Teilnahme an regelmäßigen Kunden- und Partnerreisen. Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt auf Influencer Campaign Management und Account Management. Business Development ist ein ergänzender Bestandteil deiner Aufgaben und bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv am Wachstum von LunyOne mitzuwirken. Das hybride Arbeiten ermöglicht Dir in enger Abstimmung mit Deinem Team effektiv zu kooperieren. Das bringst Du mit Must-haves Du verfügst über mindestens 1,5-2 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung im Influencer- oder KOL-Marketing – beispielsweise bei einer Agentur, einer Marke oder einer Creator-Marketing-Plattform. Du hast bereits an Influencer-Kampagnen mitgearbeitet und kennst die wesentlichen Abläufe von der Creator-Recherche über Briefings und Content-Koordination bis zum Reporting. Du sprichst Mandarin auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst sicher mit chinesischsprachigen Kunden und Geschäftspartnern kommunizieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Dich in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld sicher verständigen. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick. Du kommunizierst klar, baust Beziehungen auf und hast Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern. Du interessierst Dich für Social Media, Creator Economy und die Entwicklung des Influencer-Marktes in China und Europa. title: Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management.</p> <p>Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved.</p> <p>This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.</li> <li>Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.</li> <li>Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.</li> <li>Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team.</p> <p>Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Director, Commercial, EU Center
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h3> <p>You will report to the VP & GM EU Center and work closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Supply Chain and Finance, as well as global commercial teams, to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. Your primary purpose will be to build and lead the commercial organisation in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, preparing and executing the launches in ADH1 and achondroplasia and building the foundation for future indications. You will lead the field force, including Disease Network Specialists who will move into Key Account Manager roles after launch, and drive the local adaptation of disease awareness and marketing materials, the local execution of customer service offerings, and forecasting and demand planning, with a focus on pre-launch readiness in 2027, followed by launch execution and growth. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in rare disease commercial leadership and launch execution with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Field force leadership: Build, lead and develop the commercial field team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, including the move from pre-launch disease education to key account management after launch</li> <li>Launch readiness and execution: Own the commercial launch plans for ADH1 and achondroplasia in each country, and set up a model that can take on future indications</li> <li>Local marketing adaptation: Adapt global disease awareness and marketing materials to local needs, languages and regulations, and take them through local review and approval</li> <li>Customer service offerings: Ensure flawless local execution of HCP service offerings, together with Medical Affairs and external vendors</li> <li>Forecasting and demand planning: Own the local forecast and demand plan, align it with Supply Chain and Finance, and track performance against plan</li> <li>Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access and Patient Advocacy so that launch, access and field activities are coordinated in each country</li> <li>Compliance and governance: Make sure all commercial activities comply with HWG, the Austrian Medicines Act (AMG), the Swiss Therapeutic Products Act (HMG) and the industry codes in each country, and that clear boundaries are kept with medical activities</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Where You’ll Work</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>This is a field-based leadership role based in Germany, ideally in the Munich area, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland</li> <li>Approximately 50% travel is anticipated for field visits, customer meetings, congresses and internal meetings, including regular visits to our Zug office</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine or business. An advanced degree (MBA, PhD, PharmD) is a plus</li> <li>At least 12 years of commercial experience in pharma or biotech, including at least 5 years leading field teams, ideally in rare diseases, endocrinology or paediatrics</li> <li>Proven track record of at least one successful launch in Germany, ideally a rare disease or orphan drug launch, with experience in Austria and/or Switzerland a strong plus</li> <li>Positive, inspiring and tenacious leader, experienced in biotech build-out environments, solution-driven and hands-on, with high integrity</li> <li>Solid knowledge of forecasting, demand planning and P&L management, and of how pricing and reimbursement (AMNOG, EKO, SL) shape the commercial plan</li> <li>Comfortable using digital engagement channels and driving productivity with AI tools</li> <li>Fluent German, and fluent English to work effectively with international and US-based colleagues</li> <li>Willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>We have high expectations for our team members. title: Senior Product Designer (f/m/d)
description: About us Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has efficiently connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 students and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here. The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Designer to join our team. You are going to play a key role in shaping user experiences across Zenjob’s platform. The ideal candidate will have a passion for working hands-on across discovery, ideation, and execution, owning complex problem spaces end-to-end while collaborating closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Data partners. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex workflows, and is excited about leveraging AI-enabled tools to move faster, prototype smarter, and continuously improve the quality of design outcomes. You’ll contribute to the product strategy through design, help evolve our design system, and act as a strong craft and quality role model within the team. What You’ll Do Own end-to-end design for complex product areas, from problem discovery to high-quality execution, with clear accountability for contributing to product goals and KPIs and owning the impact of design decisions Design and prototype with a focus on responsive and adaptive design principles, ensuring a seamless and accessible user experience across all devices Conduct user research to uncover insights into user behaviors, needs, and pain points, especially in enterprise contexts, and utilize these insights to inform product decisions and build great products Be a trusted partner to product managers, engineers and stakeholders to shape solutions early and iterate fast Advocate for user-centric thinking and design excellence throughout the product lifecycle What you’ll bring 6+ years of experience as a UX Designer working on digital products A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work and measurable business impact Curiosity and openness toward AI-assisted design tools and new ways of working Proven experience collaborating in cross-functional product teams with Product and Engineering Strong UX fundamentals, with a sharp eye for interaction, visual design, and usability Ability to turn complex, real-world workflows into simple and intuitive experiences Confidence working in ambiguous problem spaces and making informed trade-offs between user needs, business goals, and technical constraints A hands-on mindset with high ownership and accountability for outcomes Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions with confidence Fluency or professional proficiency in German is a huge plus What we offer Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard. Unique team spirit : We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team. Vacation : Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave Hybrid working model : We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding). Dog-lover : If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks Personal growth : Ongoing focus on your personal development (annual training budget of EUR 750, mentoring opportunities, constant career development conversations) Healthy mind in a healthy body: With us you will receive a 30 EUR Urban Sports Club grant to keep you fit. In addition, we have a small sports room in the office ourselves. Always mobile: You will receive EUR 40 credit per month for NAVIT, a sustainable mobility tool for public transport, bike sharing and much more. Legendary Events: Quarterly team events, winter and summer parties, budget for birthdays and anniversaries of our employees If this sounds good, then we’d love to find out more about you! Apply and send in your application. 🎥 Watch our Office Tour video . We invite you to visit our careers page , follow our LinkedIn page and connect with us on Instagram . We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to judging every qualified individual on their ability, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. title: Director of Engineering
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between. Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization. We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role. What you'll do Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer. Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows. Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools. Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed. Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP. Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft. Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us. What we're looking for You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it. You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets. You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner. You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way. You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down. What sets you apart You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company. You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output. You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes; having built or run the function yourself is a plus. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. title: System Architect
description: Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact. The challenge The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards. Your responsibilities include: Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control. System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS. Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments. Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations. Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability. Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements. Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments. Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Required Skills and Competencies: Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control. Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS. Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications. Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments. Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities. Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements. Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues Education and Experience: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field. Relevant experience in intelligent building management solutions, industrial automation, and safety-critical systems. This role combines technological innovation with safety-critical applications. As a System Architect, you will develop integrated solutions that maximize comfort, safety, efficiency, and sustainability in both buildings and industrial processes. We offer A position of 32-40 hours per week with a salary to match. Challenging projects for leading clients in the Netherlands and internationally. A work environment in which innovation and sustainability are put into practice daily. Attention to your own development and vitality with ample training and development opportunities, bicycle and sports arrangements, flexible working hours, 33 vacation days and the possibility of purchasing additional days. Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office. A team where cooperation and collegiality are priority, and where we interact informally. Sustainability is in our genes. This is expressed, for example, in a mobility policy where health and sustainability are most important. Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport. About Deerns As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. Our areas of expertise contribute to sustainable, intelligent and future-proof buildings that optimally support our clients' processes. We are responsible for designing the installations and realizing good comfort and a pleasant climate in a wide variety of buildings; from offices, to airports and from hospitals to data centers. In addition, Deerns has been named a World Class Workplace for 2026! Want to know more? Would you like to know more about working at Deerns? Then contact Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) at +31 6 11 66 75 44. Would you like to know more about the role itself? Then please contact Ester Vlielander (Unit Director Electronics / Data Centers / Life Sciences) at +31 6 50 73 68 41 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Bank Balance
description: At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity. As a Senior Backend Engineer , you'll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations. If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do Build and evolve the SumUp's core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform. Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes. Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations. Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients. Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale. You'll be great for this role if You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact. You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir. You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production. You're comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes. Are fluent in relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency. You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together. You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain It's a plus if you have Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.) Why you should join SumUp Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives. Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth. Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR) Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc. Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram . title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business. Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business. The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar. Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling. It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas. Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning. This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains. What you'll be doing Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day. Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture : improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast. Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner. Supporting Engineering Excellence : Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements. Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform. Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship. AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes. 📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here . Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology. Our humble expectations Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React. Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure. Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows. Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases. Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership. Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams. Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs. Nice to Haves Experience with micro-frontend architecture. Frontend platform engineering experience. Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads. Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE). Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code). What's in it for you Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on. Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors. Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better. Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency. Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen. Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen? Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen. Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten. Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören. Über OIXIO OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht. Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren. Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT. In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen. Die Aufgabe Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut. Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung. Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche. Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung. Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten. Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind. Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen. Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI. Was Du mitbringen solltest Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen. Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt. Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite. Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären. Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch. Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst. Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen. Was gut zu uns passt Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen. Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst. Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig. Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung. Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann. Und Du hast Lust, ein Stück des OIXIO Spirits aus Estland nach Deutschland zu bringen – und ihm hier gemeinsam mit uns eine eigene Handschrift zu geben. Was wir bieten Eine konkrete Rolle beim Aufbau von OIXIO in Deutschland – mit Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein echtes Budget für Veranstaltungen, Inhalte und Medienarbeit sowie Unterstützung durch Spezialisten, wo es nötig ist. Erfahrene Fachleute in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen, die Inhalte, Demos und Vorträge beisteuern. Ein breites Leistungsportfolio rund um IT, Cybersecurity, Digitalisierung, Business-Anwendungen und Industrial IoT – mit vielen Geschichten, die erzählt werden wollen. Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit estnischer Bodenständigkeit, direkter Kommunikation und pragmatischer Zusammenarbeit. Wir erwarten viel und geben auch viel zurück: Vertrauen, Freiraum, faire Bedingungen und Menschen, auf die Du Dich verlassen kannst. Warum diese Rolle interessant ist Deutschland ist für OIXIO ein wichtiger Wachstumsmarkt. Mit unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg, einem erfahrenen Team und einem relevanten Angebot passen wir gut zu den Herausforderungen vieler mittelständischer Industrieunternehmen – jetzt muss es der Markt nur noch erfahren. Wenn Du Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mitbringst, Lust hast, eine Marke von Grund auf bekannt zu machen, und lieber mit einem guten Team als mit großen Schlagworten arbeitest, freuen wir uns auf das Gespräch mit Dir. title: Staff Engineer
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times. As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of. What you will do Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture. Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it. Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading. Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes. Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters. Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA. Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce. Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them What you bring At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money. Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title. Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance. Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems. Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus. Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus Practical details Location: Berlin, hybrid Working language: English A learning budget for your development Start date: As soon as possible We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. title: Field Service Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
description: Description Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important. As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair. You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus. This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join Quantum Diamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams. Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required. Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications. Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics. Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development. Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments. Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials. What is expected of you 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment. Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software. Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures. Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications. Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage. A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure. Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with different stakeholders. Willingness to travel internationally for approximately 80% of your working time, primarily supporting customer installations across the US, Europe, and Asia. Fluency in English; German, Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean would be a plus. A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. title: Operations Intern / Working Student (Supply Chain & Procurement) (f/m/d)
description: Beschreibung Du möchtest erleben, was es braucht, um ein Deep-Tech-Unternehmen von den ersten Prototypen bis hin zur globalen Produktion zu skalieren? QuantumDiamonds sucht einen engagierten, proaktiven und praxisorientierten Praktikant / Werkstudent im Bereich Operations , der unser wachsendes Operations-Team unterstützt und dabei Einblicke in die Bereiche Supply Chain, Einkauf, Logistik, Bestandsmanagement und ERP-Prozesse erhält. Deine Aufgaben Du erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche unseres Operations-Teams und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eigene Themen, sobald du dich bei QD eingearbeitet hast. Einkauf & Lieferantenmanagement Unterstütze das operative Tagesgeschäft im Einkauf – von der Erstellung von Bestellanforderungen und Bestellungen bis hin zur Nachverfolgung von Lieferungen. Behalte Bestellungen, Lieferzeiten und mögliche Verzögerungen im Blick und hilf dabei, Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen. Unterstütze bei Bedarf die Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit unseren Lieferanten. Logistik & Versand Koordiniere ein- und ausgehende Sendungen, einschließlich Versanddokumentation, Abholungen sowie gegebenenfalls Zoll- und Exportdokumenten. Sorge dafür, dass Materialien und Komponenten reibungslos zwischen Lieferanten, unseren Laboren, der Produktion und anderen internen Teams transportiert werden. Unterstütze beim Wareneingang und stelle sicher, dass Materialien bei den richtigen Personen und am richtigen Ort ankommen. Bestandsmanagement & ERP Hilf dabei, Materialverfügbarkeit und Lagerbestände transparent zu halten, damit unsere Teams jederzeit über die benötigten Komponenten verfügen. Pflege Lieferanten-, Einkaufs-, Bestands- und Materialdaten in unserem Odoo-ERP-System und stelle deren Aktualität und Genauigkeit sicher. Unterstütze uns dabei, unsere ERP-Daten strukturiert, zuverlässig und für unser weiteres Wachstum nutzbar zu halten. Prozesse & Operations-Projekte Identifiziere Möglichkeiten, unsere Logistik-, Einkaufs- und Supply-Chain Prozesse einfacher, effizienter und skalierbar zu gestalten, und hilf aktiv bei der Umsetzung. Unterstütze bei Datenanalysen, Dokumentationen und weiteren Operations-Projekten – abhängig von deinen Interessen und den aktuellen Prioritäten des Teams. Arbeite eng mit Engineering, Produktion und anderen Teams zusammen, um alltägliche operative Herausforderungen zu lösen. title: Doctorant(e) "Développement et caractérisation d’une plateforme multi-capteurs pour le monitoring de sites de stockage onshore de CO2" - Contrat doctoral
description: ENGLISH VERSION Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur. Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de recherche et innovation et, dans une moindre mesure de nos missions d’enseignement. Vous serez affecté au centre SPIN – LGF (Laboratoire Georges Friedel, UMR CNRS 5307). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux. Il possède également des compétences en développement de capteurs et d’instrumentation. Les technologies de captage et stockage du CO2 sont des technologies clés pour la décarbonation du secteur industriel. Les stockages offshores ont déjà démontré leur faisabilité, mais les stockages onshores semblent nécessaires pour augmenter les capacités de stockage tout en réduisant le transport de CO2. Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale. La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2. Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN, du BRGM, de Mines Saint-Etienne et de Cerema. La surveillance à long terme nécessite des outils fiables et performants, notamment dans le domaine des capteurs environnementaux, ce qui soulève la question de la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives pour traiter le signal, ainsi que celle de l'influence des variations à long terme des paramètres externes sur la réponse des capteurs (et de l'impact du changement climatique). Étant donné que les signaux de concentration en CO₂ peuvent, à eux seuls, ne pas être suffisamment discriminants (les concentrations biologiques dans les sols pouvant dépasser 10 % vol.), compte tenu de leurs origines diverses (sources profondes, provenant du stockage ou de l’interaction gaz-roche ; processus de respiration ; oxydation du méthane), la prévention des faux positifs dans la surveillance des sites de stockage doit s'appuyer sur des capteurs de CO₂ (NDIR ou photoacoustiques) et sur d'autres capteurs (par exemple, un capteur chimique d'O₂), ainsi que sur des capteurs environnementaux (humidité, pression, température) afin de permettre une attribution correcte de la source de CO2. Parmi les missions qui lui seront attribuées, le doctorant devra : · Sélectionner des capteurs existants répondants aux spécifications afin de mettre au point une plateforme de détection · Etudier, en conditions de laboratoire, la sélectivité des capteurs vis-à-vis des espèces gazeuses interférentes, à l’aide d’une analyse multivariée · Définir des algorithmes de prédiction tenant compte de la reproductibilité, de la dérive, de la linéarité et de la variabilité dans des mélanges gazeux complexes et des conditions environnementales variables (température, pression et humidité relative) · Etudier l'influence du vieillissement des capteurs sur leur réponse et sur les prévisions établies, afin de proposer un algorithme de compensation · Enfin, mener des études de cas concrets sur le site de Sainte-Marguerite (Puy-de-Dôme), avec des niveaux d'émissions de CO₂ variables, afin de tester et de valider les plateformes de capteurs développées. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un : · Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent Et idéalement : · Titulaire d’un de master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Mesure / Instrumentation / Métrologie ; Acquisition, traitement et analyse de la donnée · Avec une expérience de stage ou professionnelle dans la recherche (goût prononcé pour la partie expérimentale) · Junior accepté : oui Vos atouts supplémentaires : • La thématique du sujet étant multidisciplinaire de solides connaissances en instrumentations / capteurs, traitements de données, analyse multivariée seront nécessaires. D’autres part, des connaissances en probabilités / statistiques seront également appréciées. • Le sujet comporte un volet expérimental important mais de solides connaissances numériques seront utiles pour la partie traitement des données (notamment codage sur python) • Aptitudes pour la communication orale et écrite (notamment en langue anglaise) 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde . Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : · Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain · Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an · Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail. Mise en œuvre des outils de la plateforme (DRX, FRX, ICP-MS, ATG/DSC, granulométrie laser, etc. Validation et application du protocole de bifurcation technique pour orienter chaque lot vers la voie optimale. Ø Développement et optimisation des matrices liantes. Pilotage des formulations expérimentales en laboratoire pour les deux voies de valorisation afin de lever les verrous scientifiques majeurs (gestion du soufre et des inhibiteurs de prise comme le ZnO). Conception et optimisation des formulations de géopolymères. Optimisation des programmes de frittage des céramiques denses. Ø Évaluation de la durabilité, de la conformité réglementaire et lixiviation. Assurer la qualification technique et environnementale des matériaux développés pour garantir leur transférabilité vers le marché de la construction. Réaliser les tests de performance mécanique et de durabilité (stabilité face à l'expansion sulfatique). Conduire les tests de lixiviation normalisés (NF EN 12457-2) pour démontrer la conformité réglementaire vis-à-vis des seuils de stockage (ISDI) et participer à la rédaction technique de la proposition d’une fiche matière GAMAA et d’un dossier technique d’application. Ø Analyse de Cycle de Vie et de soutenabilité. Collecte des données d'inventaire Participation à la modélisation pour quantifier les bénéfices (réduction du CO2) et à l’évaluation des dimensions socio-économiques locales. Ø Gestion de projet, animation du partenariat et valorisation scientifique. Assurer le suivi opérationnel quotidien du projet VARIMA et la diffusion des connaissances au sein de l'écosystème concerné. Participation à l’encadrement des stagiaires associés aux travaux et maintien d’un lien technique étroit avec le partenaire industriel pour le partage des résultats. Rédaction des rapports d'avancement du projet. Valorisation des résultats à travers la rédaction d'articles scientifiques internationaux à comité de lecture, participation à des congrès, et contribution à la détection d'opportunités de brevets. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un : Doctorat (PhD) ou équivalent en Chimie des matériaux, Sciences et Génie des matériaux ou des procédés, Génie civil.
