title: Stagiair(e) Marketing
description: Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing? We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing. Wat ga je doen? Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen. Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals: Vormgeving; Webinarproducties; Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud; E-mail marketing; Social media; Deep dive in de analytics; Meedenken in plannen rondom AI. Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan. Met wie werk je samen? Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren. Maud over haar stage bij 12Build: “12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.” Wie is 12Build? 12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren. title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: Word jij onze nieuwe QA Specialist in Klazienaveen? Ben jij een kwaliteitsprofessional die energie krijgt van verbeteren, adviseren en het borgen van kwaliteit? Wil je werken in een organisatie waar je echt impact kunt maken en waar jouw expertise bijdraagt aan veilige en hoogwaardige producten? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Als QA Specialist ben jij een belangrijke schakel binnen ons Quality Team. Je draagt actief bij aan het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van onze kwaliteitssystemen en ondersteunt de organisatie bij het voldoen aan GMP-, FSSC 22000- en ISO-eisen. Met jouw kritische blik, analytisch vermogen en verbetergerichte mindset help je onze processen elke dag een stap beter te maken. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's, met name van QC om kwaliteit, compliance en continue verbetering binnen de organisatie te waarborgen. Wat ga je doen? Adviseren van de organisatie op basis van data- en procesanalyses om kwaliteitsprestaties continu te verbeteren. Onderhouden en optimaliseren van het kwaliteitsmanagementsysteem. Coördineren en opstellen van de jaarlijkse management review. Initiëren, begeleiden en opvolgen van interne en externe audits. Beheren van afwijkingen, klachten, CAPA's en verbeteracties. Beoordelen en beheren van wijzigingen en uitvoeren van risicoanalyses. Uitvoeren van trendanalyses en vertalen van bevindingen naar verbetermaatregelen. Signaleren van kwaliteitsrisico's en proactief initiëren van verbeteringen. Nauw samenwerken met QC bij het beoordelen van analyseresultaten, afwijkingen, kwaliteitsrisico's en verbeterinitiatieven. Fungeren als sparringpartner voor QC en Operations op het gebied van kwaliteitsvraagstukken, compliance en continue verbetering. Ondersteunen bij leverancierskwalificaties en het monitoren van leveranciersprestaties. Ondersteunen bij validatie- en verificatieactiviteiten van processen, systemen en methoden. Beheren van kwaliteitsdocumentatie in Manual Master. Ondersteunen van verbeterprojecten binnen de organisatie. Verzorgen van kwaliteitstrainingen en bijdragen aan het kwaliteitsbewustzijn binnen de organisatie. Vrijgeven van producten conform GMP-, FSSC 22000- en ISO 9001-eisen. Requirements Een relevante HBO-opleiding. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen de (proces)industrie. Ervaring met kwaliteitsmanagementsystemen, audits, afwijkingenbeheer en CAPA's. Ervaring met Change Control, risicoanalyses en continue verbeterprogramma's. Ervaring met trendanalyses en het werken met kwaliteits-KPI's. Kennis en/of ervaring met GMP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 en FSSC 22000. Ervaring met een documentmanagementsysteem, bij voorkeur Manual Master. Ervaring met Power BI voor data-analyse en rapportages is een pré. Kennis van validatie- en kwalificatieprocessen is een pré. Ervaring met grondoorzaakanalyses (bijvoorbeeld 5 Why's of Fishbone) is een pré. Een zelfstandige werkhouding, eigenaarschap en een pragmatische instelling. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Benefits Een uitdagende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheden en ruimte voor eigen initiatief Een informele organisatie met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's. Een cultuur waarin samenwerken, leren en verbeteren centraal staan. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, opleidingen en on-the-job learning. Een werkomgeving waarin jouw bijdrage daadwerkelijk verschil maakt. Wat bieden wij? Salaris tussen € 4.700 en € 6.000 bruto per maand met 8% vakantiegeld en 13e maand, afhankelijk van de ervaring van de kandidaat; ▪ vakantiedagen - 25 dagen, 25 vakantiedagen per jaar. Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Lead (Finance & Internal Tools)
description: <p><strong>About Workwize</strong></p> <p>Workwize helps companies equip their remote and global teams with IT equipment. Our SaaS platform takes care of buying, delivering, managing and returning laptops and other devices in more than 100 countries. Today more than 50,000 users and 120,000 devices are managed through Workwize.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>You will lead the team that builds the systems behind our finance and internal operations. That means billing, invoicing and the internal tools our Operations and Finance teams use every day. The team is small but has a big impact. Mistakes here are expensive, so quality and good judgement matter.</p> <p>You lead the engineers, work closely with the team's Product Manager and report to the Engineering Manager. You also work directly with senior leadership. You own the people, the way the team works and the delivery of the roadmap. You stay close to the code: about 30 to 40% of your time goes to code reviews, technical design and some hands-on work.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and grow your engineers through 1:1s, clear feedback and growth plans</li> <li>Set a clear bar for performance, and act early when someone is not meeting it</li> <li>Own delivery of the team's roadmap and keep progress, risks and blockers visible</li> <li>Plan the roadmap and quarterly goals with Product, Operations and Finance, including what we say no to</li> <li>Run planning, refinement and retros, and represent the team in talks with other teams</li> <li>Keep standards high on code review, testing, monitoring, security and incident follow-up</li> <li>Hire new engineers for your team</li> <li>Set good habits for using AI tools in development</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years as a software engineer, including at least 1 to 2 years managing engineers with direct reports</li> <li>Experience handling performance issues: setting expectations, giving hard feedback and supporting someone who is struggling</li> <li>A leadership style that can switch between directing and coaching, depending on the situation</li> <li>Confidence to explain and defend your point of view to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Hands-on experience with a modern web stack. We use Laravel (PHP), Node.js, React, Filament and MySQL. You don't need to know all of them, because strong engineers learn them fast</li> <li>A track record of delivering B2B web products end to end, working with non-technical colleagues</li> <li>Daily use of AI tools in your development work</li> <li>Clear written and spoken English (Dutch is not needed)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in FinTech, or with finance and billing systems (invoicing, order-to-cash, tax, or accounting and ERP integrations like Exact or QuickBooks)</li> <li>Experience with Laravel Filament or other admin panel tools, or moving internal tools off low-code platforms like Retool</li> <li>Experience building LLM features or AI agents for internal operations</li> <li>Scale-up experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, logistics or operations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Where you will work</strong></p> <ul> <li>In the Netherlands: hybrid, 2 to 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office</li> <li>Elsewhere in EMEA: remote, with working hours that overlap with CET and occasional visits to Amsterdam</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our hiring process</strong></p> <ol> <li>Call with Talent Acquisition</li> <li>Short video interview</li> <li>Team fit interview</li> <li>Technical interview</li> <li>Case study: two short role-play scenarios with the panel. title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
description: Over ons De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is. In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur. Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen. Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen. Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid. Jouw kwalificaties Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar). Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen. Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren. Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken. Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen. Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is. In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators. Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. Hoe succes eruitziet Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur , en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand. Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team , door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving. Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen , door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving. Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden , snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving. Onze werkcultuur Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is. Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst. Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt. Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie. Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken. If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI</h1> <p>Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.</p> <p>We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.</p> <p>This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and shipping <strong>end-to-end AI agents</strong> that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more</li> <li><strong>Crossing organizational boundaries</strong> to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission</li> <li>Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity</li> <li>Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions</li> </ul> <h2>You Should Have</h2> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of software engineering experience</strong>; you've built with LLMs extensively — whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself</li> <li><strong>Strong product instincts</strong>: you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec</li> <li><strong>LLM fluency</strong>: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos</li> <li><strong>Full-stack capability</strong> in TypeScript and Next.js—you can own a feature end to end</li> <li><strong>An entrepreneurial drive</strong>: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication</strong>: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself</li> <li><strong>An audacious appetite for impact</strong>: you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)</li> <li>Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications</li> </ul> <h2>How We Work</h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together</li> <li>We have the latest hardware and software—including frontier AI models on day one</li> <li>We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best</li> <li><strong>Stack</strong>: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Is Special</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your work is visible</strong>: This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction</li> <li><strong>Real stakes</strong>: thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact</li> <li><strong>Full ownership</strong>: from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours</li> <li><strong>You're early</strong>: the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you: </strong></h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car</a>, a <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/579-fossils">Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton</a>, <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/l/10035805">Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit</a> or <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/en/c/583-sports-memorabilia">Usain Bolt’s running shoe</a>, we encounter exceptional objects every day.</p> <p>We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.</p> <p>Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.</p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership and driving impact </li> <li>Being open to change and feedback</li> <li>Being passionate about our mission and our customers. </li> </ul></div><h3>Your mission</h3> <p>As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.</p> <p>The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.</p> <p>You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.</li> <li><strong>Build dependable data foundations:</strong> Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen production ML:</strong> Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.</li> <li><strong>Advance marketplace models:</strong> Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Set direction and priorities:</strong> Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.</li> <li><strong>Shape the technology strategy:</strong> Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <p>You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.</p> <p>Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical depth in one discipline:</strong> Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Architecture and systems thinking:</strong> Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.</li> <li><strong>Production ML understanding:</strong> Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.</li> <li><strong>Business and product judgement:</strong> Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Relevant cloud platform experience:</strong> We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.</li> <li><strong>Streaming and integration experience:</strong> Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication:</strong> Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How we work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.</li> <li>The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.</li> <li>Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.</li> <li>The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Where you'll be</strong></h3> <p>This is a <em>hybrid</em> role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="text text-align-left "> <h3><strong>Why You'll Love Working with Us</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Create a visible impact </strong>by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.</li> <li><strong>Learn and grow</strong> through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.</li> <li><strong>A culture of connection defines us</strong>. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate life’s moments with us. </strong>You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion<strong>”</strong>. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Offices and Way of Working</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.</p> </div> <h3><strong>Interested?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to <a href="https://www.catawiki.com/conditions/applicant-privacy-policy.pdf">Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy.</a> If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

You will be responsible for leading the sales team’s success in achieving quarterly sales targets, collaborating with internal production stakeholders to meet customer product delivery commitments, and developing a high-performing sales organization. Sales Strategies: Work with the account managers, Product, and Business Development to drive sales growth across target regions and customers. FAE management: Establish FAE goals to ensure a positive customer experience with pre-sales and post-sales technical support Partner with Business Development: Work closely with Business Development (BD) leadership to ensure Sales and BD are coordinated across Strategic Accounts and Government tenders. Customer Relationship Management Voice of the Customer: Ensure the sales team plays a strong role internally at QW as the voice of the customer, relaying customer feedback regarding delivery and product performance, as well as communicating new developments in customer requirements, Contract Negotiation: Lead product pricing negotiations in coordination with the account management team and Product Management Your Profile Experience: 5+ years of sales experience in a technical or deep-tech industry. Leadership: 3+ years of experience building, leading, and scaling high-performing sales teams. Ecosystem Experience: Experience working with a diverse partner ecosystem, including Value-Added Resellers (VARs), systems integrators, distributors, and other strategic channel partners. Technical Acumen: Ability to engage credibly with customers, partners, and the quantum computing ecosystem, while collaborating effectively with Product and Engineering leadership. Education: Bachelor’s degree required. A degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is strongly preferred. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening. title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description: Keep our supply chain moving – ensuring 100% material availability for next-level radar systems. As our Senior Procurement Specialist, you keep our supply chain running smoothly and secure critical components for high-tech radars. You own key supplier relationships, resolve complex delivery bottlenecks, and mentor junior buyers across the team. Working closely with Production, Logistics, Service & Support, and Sales, you ensure parts arrive on time. You report to the Head of Procurement and keep our production line moving without a hitch. Focus on high-complexity categories like PCBs, custom cabling, and computer components. description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability. title: Group Product Manager

Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap. Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams. AI intuition: you stay current on models, frameworks, and evaluation methods — not as a researcher, but with the hands-on curiosity of a builder. Why Prosus? mix of on-site in our Taipei office and remote from home.   Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.</p> <h2>What your day will look like </h2> <ul> <li>Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.   </li> <li>Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed. </li> <li>Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.</li> <li>Negotiate successful contracts.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.</li> <li>Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.</li> <li>Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels</li> <li>Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Additional skills that you might also bring</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.</li> <li>Team leadership or program management experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.</p> <p>You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br> fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br> network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br> unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br> taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br> on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br> experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>As a Technical Program Manager in GitLab’s R&D organization, you’ll lead cross functional initiatives that help teams deliver reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You’ll own programs that cut across multiple product stages and engineering teams, turning strategic priorities into clear plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving progress in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You’ll use GitLab issues, epics, and handbook-first documentation to create visibility, remove blockers, and keep complex work moving across time zones, while partnering closely with Engineering Leadership at all levels. evolving Technical Program Management best practices.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead 1–3 strategic technical programs at a time spanning multiple engineering teams and product stages, ensuring clear scope, priorities, and outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with engineering leaders and other key stakeholders to align on goals, timelines, and delivery milestones for cross functional initiatives.</li> <li>Own end-to-end program planning and execution, from initial discovery and scoping through delivery, measurement, and retrospectives.</li> <li>Drive asynchronous collaboration using GitLab issues, epics, and handbook updates so globally distributed teams stay aligned and informed.</li> <li>Identify risks and blockers early, coordinate resolution across teams, and escalate when needed to maintain momentum.</li> <li>Facilitate working group meetings and async discussions to support decision-making, surface tradeoffs, and keep programs on track.</li> <li>Track and communicate program health through metrics, dashboards, and regular status updates to provide visibility to the Engineering Division and partners.</li> <li>Contribute to evolving Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar technical roles.</li> <li>Understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile ways of working, including how engineering teams plan, build, and ship.</li> <li>Skill in coordinating programs across multiple engineering teams or departments, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, and milestones.</li> <li>Strong written communication skills for asynchronous, documentation-first collaboration in a fully remote environment.</li> <li>Ability to work independently in a distributed setting, set priorities, and make progress with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying blockers, and proposing practical solutions to keep programs moving.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or platforms like GitLab, with interest in deepening this knowledge over time.</li> <li>Openness to learning, iterating based on feedback, and applying transferable skills from varied backgrounds to technical program management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>You’ll join the R&D organization as part of the Technical Program Management function, a small, cross-functional team that leads high-impact programs spanning multiple product stages and departments. title: Sr. Solutions Engineer ( MSSP )
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Sr. Solutions Engineer, you will be tasked with driving adoption, building strong partner relationships, and evangelizing our solutions across the region. You will focus on enabling the MSSP ecosystem, positioning and integrating SentinelOne's technology within partner technical offerings, selling to the managed partner base, conducting demos, delivering technical training, Proof of Values, assisting partners with pre and post sales activities, and assisting with escalations. Your role will be responsible for managing our MSSP partners, while cultivating long-term relationships with partners, and the SentinelOne field and Product/Engineering teams.</span></p> <h3>What will you do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Work with the Managed partner team to identify and qualify partnership opportunities, identify key partner technical objections, competition, and develop strategies to resolve technical blockers and scale the partner sales business</li> <li>Bring feedback from partners and end customers to product management to improve the SentinelOne's solution</li> <li>Drive follow-ups with partner resources to consistently deliver on messaging how SentinelOne adds value to the partner and their customers.</li> <li>Plan and create go-to-market initiatives and offerings with SentinelOne partners</li> <li>Develop and execute technical training plans for partners.</li> <li>Own the technical relationship with SentinelOne's partners, and the coordination of additional technical resources.</li> <li>Deliver demonstrations and work hands-on with partners to demonstrate SentinelOne's value in the partner's environment or solutions.</li> </ul> <h3>What skills and knowledge should you bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li class="li1">10 Years+ in field, 5+ years Sales Engineering experience</li> <li class="li1">Exceptional track record of growing managed partner technical resources</li> <li class="li1">Strong background in building relationships with internal sales and product teams</li> <li class="li1">Experience presenting and delivering technical demos and sales values presentations to varying audiences from architects to C-level executives.</li> <li class="li1">Technical experience/skills for the successful candidate:</li> <li class="li1">Experience working with CSPs, channel, MSP/MSSPs, GSIs, or alliances partners.</li> <li class="li1">Ability to quickly learn, adapt, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions </li> <li class="li1">Fluent Dutch and English</li> <li class="li1">Willingness to travel up to 50%</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness & Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Employer Branding Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Our team’s mission is to align Vinted’s values, business goals, and Employer Value Proposition with our people’s real work experience. We translate Vinted’s truth into an inspiring story that attracts the right people, helps them grow, and instils them with pride.</p> <p>You’ll take an active role in Employer Branding at Vinted, with a particular focus on attracting engineering and data science talent. You’ll be based in Amsterdam, where our data science team is growing, but your work will reach candidates around the world.</p> <p>Vinted has become an ecosystem with vertically integrated shipping and payments. This requires us to adapt our EVP to three very distinct brands and even more diversified hiring needs. Your job is to turn that into creative campaigns and stories that make specific audiences want to work here.</p> <p>Our next big focus is storytelling. Bringing the skills and challenges our teams face to life! What is a day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst? How does an anti-money laundering expert keep members’ wallets safe? What does it take to build the data science behind a marketplace used by millions? And what stories does each of our locations need?</p> <p>Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering and data science leaders, People, Marketing, PR, Internal Comms, and Brand & Design, you’ll make sure those stories are told and that our presence is strong where we hire.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Be the guardian of Vinted’s employer brand, ensuring consistency and visibility across all platforms, like LinkedIn and Instagram</li> <li>Strong brand-building skills, with a clear vision of global vs local branding differentiation</li> <li>Use your sound understanding of branding and our editorial guidelines to write clear and engaging copy for things such as blogs, advertising campaigns, employer branding assets, email campaigns, event materials, online company profiles, as well as our careers pages.</li> <li>Create bespoke or support partnership events such as meetups, webinars, and networking events</li> <li>Plan and run recruitment advertising, such as targeted LinkedIn campaigns and sponsorships with third-party publications and organisations, aimed at technical audiences.</li> <li>Define where our global employer brand ends and local adaptation begins, so each location can tell its story while staying consistent with Vinted’s.</li> <li>Shape our content calendar around hiring needs and our location strategy.</li> <li>Track what works, using results to sharpen the next activation, and share learnings with the wider Employer Branding team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Passionate about all things Employer Branding!</li> <li>You love storytelling: finding stories and having a keen eye for telling them in ways that stand out. You can show campaigns or activations you conceived and delivered.</li> <li>Background in building and nurturing online and offline communities, and delivering innovative events and social media campaigns.</li> <li>A clear view of global vs local branding, and experience working across markets.</li> <li>Adept at identifying new talent attraction channels, especially for engineering and data science audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable using data to set goals and judge what worked.</li> <li>Ability to juggle multiple projects with strong stakeholder management, and to work confidently with engineering and data science leaders.</li> <li>Excited by change, a fast pace, and learning new ways of doing things.</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of social media and digital channels, including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and Meta.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€59.800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€81.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. knowledge.</li> <li>Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</p> <p>GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams, solving the highest-scope and most complex problems in your area. You will lead large, cross-cutting backend initiatives, drive our modular architecture strategy, and define the standards that let teams move faster without compromising quality, security, reliability, or operability.</p> <p>This is a technical leadership role that combines deep backend expertise, systems judgment, product judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Engineering Managers, and engineers across product groups, bringing subject matter expertise, and you will do it without relying on formal authority.</p> <h2><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Leverage:</strong> Your work multiplies across teams. The platforms, standards, and architectural decisions you lead determine how quickly everyone else can ship.</li> <li><strong>Genuinely Hard Problems:</strong> You’ll lead the modernization of a large monolith toward modular, reusable, appropriately independent systems — at the scale of a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Bureaucracy:</strong> You’ll shape technical direction across teams through clear written proposals and decision records, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform roadmap and investment trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Frontier AI Work:</strong> You’ll lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows and define the review, quality, security, and privacy guardrails that make them safe to rely on.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Cross-Cutting Initiatives:</strong> Lead the technical design and delivery of large backend initiatives that span teams, and identify and remove systemic bottlenecks across product and infrastructure groups.</li> <li><strong>Own Architecture Strategy:</strong> Drive modular backend, service, data, and platform architecture. Lead modernization of the monolith and legacy backends toward modular, reusable, and appropriately independently operated systems — while preventing fragmentation and service sprawl.</li> <li><strong>Set the Standards:</strong> Define and improve standards for APIs, contracts, compatibility, schema evolution, testing, security, performance, observability, operability, and maintainability — plus the build, test, deploy, release, rollback, and production-readiness practices needed to operate modular features safely.</li> <li><strong>Establish Shared Patterns:</strong> Create the patterns for dependency management, data ownership, eventing, failure isolation, service maturity, and operational documentation. Establish Go service patterns and Kubernetes operating practices where they matter to our production estate, and guide Rust adoption where it solves a real systems, security, performance, or supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during complex incidents, and turn what you learn into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence.</li> <li><strong>Influence and Partner:</strong> Shape technical direction across teams without formal authority, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership on platform-level roadmap decisions and investment trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Grow Engineers:</strong> Mentor Senior and Intermediate engineers, shepherd technical debt reduction and reusable patterns that improve throughput, and raise the technical capability of the wider team.</li> <li><strong>Lead AI Adoption:</strong> Lead team-level adoption of AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including the quality, security, privacy, and operational guardrails, and help engineers direct, validate, reject, and course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more than one team or a broad product area.</li> <li><strong>Deep Architecture Experience:</strong> Deep backend architecture and production experience in complex applications, services, or platforms, including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including
